And your ability to be consistent day in and day out to show up and perform and learn. Pay This is output-based freelance work and should be viewed as a flexible side hustle with growth potential. - $10 per completed batch of video clips per recipe - $5 for edits/revision batches. description: Job Description: Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist Job Overview We are looking for a savvy, culturally fluent Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist to join our marketing and brand reputation team. In this role, you will be the eyes, ears, and voice of our brand across Reddit, Quora, and other niche online forums. This isn't about traditional customer service or spamming links; it’s about authentic engagement. You will find relevant conversations, provide genuine value to users, subtly insert our brand where appropriate, and protect our reputation in the digital spaces where our audience naturally hangs out. Key Responsibilities 1. Active Monitoring & Listening Monitor mentions of our brand, competitors, and industry keywords, can utilize social listening tools (e.g., Brand24, Mention, Awario, or Reddit-specific trackers) Track sentiment and identify emerging trends, pain points, or viral discussions within relevant subreddits and forums. 2. Authentic Engagement & Advocacy Participate daily in relevant discussions on Reddit, Quora, Discord, and other niche communities. Own the monthly delivery KPI for naturally placed client brand mentions across Reddit, Quora, and other relevant online communities. Deliver approximately 50 approved brand mentions per month across all active clients, with volume adjusted based on client scope, quality standards, and available opportunities. Brand mentions may be delivered through a mixture of original posts, comments, answers, and other relevant community placements, depending on what feels most natural for each platform and conversation. Provide helpful, high-quality, and objective answers to user questions, establishing yourself as a trusted community member. Subtly and organically introduce the relevant client’s product or service only when it genuinely adds value to the conversation. Manage multiple personas/accounts carefully and ethically, while following the specific rules, tone, and netiquette of each subreddit or community. Identify and complete additional signal/linking opportunities where relevant, including Quora answers, niche forum mentions, directory submissions, and other community-based visibility opportunities. Track every opportunity from discovery to placement, including client, platform, thread/page URL, status, live link, removal risk, account used, and notes. Escalate blockers early when KPI delivery is at risk due to moderation rules, account limitations, lack of relevant threads, or client-fit issues. 3. Crisis Management & Feedback Loop Identify negative sentiment, misinformation, or customer complaints early and de-escalate them constructively. Act as the bridge between online communities and our product/marketing teams, relaying valuable user feedback, feature requests, and competitor insights. Escalate blockers early when KPI delivery is at risk due to moderation rules, account limitations, lack of relevant threads, or client-fit issues. 4. Strategy & Reporting Collaborate with the SEO and Content teams to identify high-intent threads that can drive qualified referral traffic. Track key performance metrics, including comment upvotes, reach, referral traffic, and sentiment shifts, providing weekly/monthly reports to management. Skills and Qualifications Minimum Requirements Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Social Media Management, Community Management, or Digital Marketing. Reddit Fluency: A deep, native understanding of Reddit culture, memes, formatting, karma systems, and strict subreddit moderation rules. Writing Excellence: Exceptional written English skills with the ability to adapt your tone—ranging from highly technical and authoritative to casual and conversational. Thick Skin & Tact: Ability to handle internet trolls, skepticism, and negative feedback with grace, humor, and professionalism. Preferred Qualifications Experience using social listening and monitoring software. Basic understanding of SEO and how forum backlinks/mentions impact search visibility. An active personal Reddit account with a healthy history of karma and community participation (highly preferred). What We Offer Compensation: Commensurate to experience Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the world Flexible work environment with supportive team culture Opportunity to work with innovative SaaS brands Clear growth paths and skill development opportunities Transparent, goal-driven workflows HOW TO APPLY Submission Requirements (Mandatory) At MADX, we prioritize clear communication and the ability to follow technical specifications. title: Product Manager
description: What you'll own Each of our clients is an AI consumer company trying to turn a launch into pipeline. Your job is to own one of those launches end-to-end - we call this a play. Get content out the door fast. Measure and iterate. Track posts, views, conversions. Run experiments on hook, format, and CTA. Weekly decisions on what to kill and what to scale. Report. Weekly written update on the play: what shipped, what we learned, what's next. Direct dialogue with the client founder. Who this is for This page exists because we believe great operators get priced out of the global tech market for reasons that have nothing to do with their ability. We want to find them and pay them fairly for the value they create, while building the most diverse and capable PM team in creator marketing. Self-taught is welcome. We do not care about which university you went to or any school credential. Show us what you've shipped and what you watch and how you think. Ships things. You have launched something. A TikTok account, a Shopify store, a Discord community, a Substack, a side product. Anything where you had to make 100 small decisions and learn from outcomes. Lives on short-form video. You can name 5 creator accounts you follow in different niches and explain exactly why each one works. Bonus if some are South East Asian creators - we want that local context. AI-native. You don't just use ChatGPT. You build small things with Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ElevenLabs, Runway. Whatever the job needs. Comfortable with async + overlap hours. Most work is on your own schedule, but you can do 2-4 hours of US or EU overlap a few times a week for client calls. What you have shipped matters more than any school you went to. What you'll get Paid in USD. $400-$600/month base depending on hours and experience, plus performance bonus tied to your play's outcomes. Your name on the work, directly visible to the founders of the AI products we're launching. The 8x playbook. Every internal SOP, every creator network, every tool. We hand you what took 18 months to build. Direct path to extend. 3-month role to start. Top performers extend or convert to permanent roles at increased comp. Mentorship from the team. Weekly 1:1 with the head of plays. Direct line to the CEO when you need it. The same operating context the EU team gets. $3M+ Run rate 100k+ Creators in network 30+ Countries About 8x Social 8x Social is the infrastructure layer for performance-driven creator marketing. We work with the fastest-growing AI consumer companies to turn their launches into pipeline, connecting them with 100k+ creators across 30+ countries. Founded by Jaka Bavdek (CEO, London Business School) and Theo Bui (CTO, Imperial College), we're backed by Entrepreneur First and based in San Francisco. We're the fastest-growing company in EF history. We are explicitly building a globally distributed PM team because we believe talent is everywhere even when opportunity isn't. Finished quality deliverables are what count. •       Communication is in writing first (ClickUp comments and email ), with a weekly tea ---------- eting video call. •       We expect a few hours of overlap with US business hours for communication; the rest of your schedule is flexible. title: Senior Marketing Assistant
description: Title: Senior Marketing Assistant — Video Editing (Virtual) Reports To: Karly, Digital Marketing Specialist Location: Remote, Philippines (Austin, TX business hours overlap required) Type: Full-time contractor Compensation: $1,800 – $2,000/month USD, plus 13th-month pay paid in December, prorated by tenure. Start Date: ~30 days ============================================================ ABOUT BRAMLETT PARTNERS ============================================================ Bramlett Partners is the fastest-growing independent residential real estate brokerage in Austin, TX. We support approximately 148 agents who close 1,300+ transactions and over $775M in volume annually. Our operating philosophy: amazing client service drives 5-star reviews and referrals. Technology, content, and systems are how we scale that standard without adding complexity. We are a technology-forward brokerage. Every tea ---------- mber is expected to use AI daily to work faster, smarter, and more independently. ============================================================ ROLE SUMMARY ============================================================ You will be the video editing engine behind Bramlett Partners' content marketing. You report directly to Karly and collaborate in real time with her on every project. Your job is execution: take raw interview footage, B-roll, and photos and turn them into clean, story-driven videos that get our agents and the Austin neighborhoods we serve in front of the right audiences. Beyond video, you will also produce supporting graphic design assets in Canva — video cover images, award and publication-feature posts, and brand-aligned carousels — using Karly's brand guide as your reference. Video editing is the primary role; design is a meaningful secondary responsibility, not an afterthought. This is a hands-on creative role. Karly is currently doing all of this editing and design herself, which means she is in the weeds instead of focused on grander marketing campaigns. Your success is measured by how much creative work you take off her plate without dropping quality. By day 90, the goal is that Karly is reviewing your cuts and designs, not making them. This role requires good judgment and taste. Transcripts, AI captions, and editing tools are starting points — they are not decision-makers. You will be expected to feel pacing, hear when a cut lands, and recognize when an interview ---------- nt needs to breathe versus when it needs to be tightened. If you have edited a lot of video and have strong instincts about story, this role is for you. If you are looking for a checklist-execution job, this is not the right fit. SEE OUR WORK ------------ Before applying, study our existing video and design work: - Instagram: ---------- - YouTube: ---------- This is the visual standard, tone, and pacing you will be matching and elevating. If you cannot deliver work at or above this level, this is not the right role for you. ============================================================ SCOPE AND PHASING ============================================================ PHASE 1: DAYS 1-30 (ORIGIN STORIES) - Learn Karly's editing style, prebuilt templates, and brand standards inside and out - Take ownership of agent origin story edits — interview cuts, B-roll layering, music, captions - Deliver one published-quality origin story per week by day 30 - Begin producing video cover images and basic graphic assets in Canva using the brand guide - Daily video check-ins with Karly to review cuts, get feedback, and learn the judgment model - Get fluent with CapCut, Epidemic Sound, Canva, and Karly's existing template library PHASE 2: DAYS 31-60 (ADD BUSINESS PROFILES) - Take over business profile editing (interview + B-roll). Target 3 published profiles per month - Begin owning the full creative pipeline for origin stories — Karly reviews final, not first cuts - Take ownership of recurring graphic design work: video covers, award/feature posts, "about us" carousels - Identify recurring B-roll needs and flag gaps for future filming - Daily check-ins continue but shorten as you demonstrate independence PHASE 3: DAYS 61-90 (ADD NEIGHBORHOOD SPOTLIGHTS) - Take over neighborhood spotlight edits (combining multiple business profiles + neighborhood B-roll) - Deliver 1 neighborhood spotlight per month - Earned autonomy on origin stories — Karly reviews only when you flag for review - Own the design pipeline end-to-end for recurring formats; Karly reviews one-offs - Daily check-ins transition to weekly 1:1s - (Stretch) Begin shadowing podcast editing in Riverside if Karly d ---------- to shift ownership of that workstream ============================================================ CORE RESPONSIBILITIES ============================================================ ORIGIN STORIES - What you own: Edit agent origin story videos from interview footage + B-roll + photos. Cut to a clean narrative arc, layer B-roll, score with music, add captions and on-screen elements. - Success metric: One origin story published per week. Day-30 target: own this end-to-end. BUSINESS PROFILES - What you own: Edit local business profile videos (interview + B-roll). Match tone of the business, build a story, deliver social-ready cuts. - Success metric: 3 business profiles published per month. Day-60 target: own this end-to-end. NEIGHBORHOOD SPOTLIGHTS - What you own: Combine multiple business profiles + neighborhood B-roll into a longer-form spotlight piece. Strong pacing, clear story, music that elevates. - Success metric: 1 neighborhood spotlight per month. Day-90 target: own this end-to-end. GRAPHIC DESIGN (CANVA) - What you own: Produce supporting design assets — video cover images, award and publication-feature posts, "about us" carousels, and one-off brand-aligned graphics. Recurring formats use templates; one-offs are built from scratch using the brand guide. - Success metric: Designs match brand standards on first pass. Karly approves rather than rebuilds. B-ROLL + ASSET MANAGEMENT - What you own: Review raw footage, log usable B-roll, organize project files in Drive so the team can find anything fast. - Success metric: Zero lost or unfindable assets. Project files organized to a documented standard. CAPTIONS + ON-SCREEN ELEMENTS - What you own: Generate AI captions in CapCut, match Karly's prebuilt template, add lower-thirds and on-screen graphics consistent with brand. - Success metric: Captions are accurate, on-brand, and require minimal Karly edits. MUSIC + SOUND DESIGN - What you own: Select and customize tracks (Epidemic Sound) that match tone and elevate the edit. Cut/loop tracks cleanly. - Success metric: Music choices land without rework. Audio levels mixed cleanly across dialogue, B-roll, and music. ============================================================ AI PROFICIENCY REQUIREMENTS ============================================================ This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. Every member of the Bramlett Partners team uses AI daily. You will be evaluated on your ability to use AI to work faster, generate better first drafts, and elevate your creative output. MINIMUM EXPECTATIONS: - Proficient with Claude or ChatGPT for transcript review, story structuring, copy drafting, and creative ideation - Able to write effective prompts that produce usable first drafts (not just "write me a caption") - Comfortable using AI to summarize long interview footage and identify the strongest soundbites - Willing to experiment with new AI tools and creative workflows without hand-holding WITHIN 90 DAYS, YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO: - Use Claude to scan interview transcripts and propose narrative outlines for Karly's review - Build simple Claude Projects with reference material for recurring video formats - Suggest AI-powered creative or workflow improvements to Karly ============================================================ REQUIREMENTS ============================================================ MUST HAVE - Strong demonstrated video editing portfolio. We will watch your work. - Strong storytelling instincts and a clear sense of pacing — particularly for interview-based content where the subject may be awkward on camera. Intimate and real, like I'm talking to one person, but elevated. Pacing for retention and an instinct for what's working in short-form now, without chasing every trend into the ground. ___ You're probably a fit if you >> Are fluent in CapCut, Premiere, and/or After Effects (or can show me equivalent work) >> Have a real eye for typography and motion text >> Can write or punch up a hook, not just cut to one >> Have taste that matches the references I'll send >> Hit deadlines and communicate like a pro >> Bonus: motion graphics, thumbnail/cover design, and a genuine interest in mental health, music, or brand culture. title: Full Time Video Editor
description: Experienced Video Editor for Fashion Textile Brand We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Video Editor to join our fashion textile brand full-time. This is not a basic video editing role. We are looking for someone very skilled with a strong visual eye, excellent taste, and a deep understanding of fashion, ecommerce, branding, social media, and customer psychology. Our brand sells fashion fabrics and textiles, so the videos must feel elevated, stylish, modern, feminine, fashion-oriented, and visually strong. We need someone who can create videos that do not just look nice, but also help sell, build desire, and make people stop scrolling. Our customer is a high tier customer so we need videos that convert for this type of person. We are looking for someone who is familiar with AI Videos. Even if he is not good at it right now, we need to know this person is willing to learn AI video generation Main Responsibilities You will help create video content for different platforms, including: * Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook , and Pinterest * Video ads for Meta, Google, and other paid platforms * Product-focused videos for fabrics and textile collections * Website video banners or homepage video sections * Email campaign videos or GIF-style visuals * Product launch videos * Promotional videos for sales and campaigns * Aesthetic brand videos that support our new visual direction * Simple motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, and effects * Editing raw product footage into polished, elevated videos * Adding music, sound effects, captions, graphics, and visual details * Repurposing videos into different formats and ratios for different platforms * Organizing video files, folders, footage, and creative assets * Supporting the marketing team with creative ideas and video concepts What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: * Has a very strong sense of style, taste, and aesthetics * Understands fashion, beauty, ecommerce, branding, and modern visual trends * Can make product videos feel elevated, desirable, and high-end * Understands how short-form videos work and what makes people stop scrolling * Understands customer psychology and how to create videos that attract attention and build desire * Can create videos for ads, social media, email , and website use * Has experience editing ecommerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or product-focused videos * Can work with raw footage and make it look much better through editing * Can use music, pacing, text, transitions, overlays, effects, and color in a tasteful way * Has a strong understanding of visual rhythm, timing, and storytelling * Can create videos that feel stylish and modern, not basic or generic * Can follow brand direction but also bring creative ideas * Is comfortable experimenting with different video styles * Can create reusable video templates when needed * Communicates clearly and can take feedback professionally * Is organized, reliable, and detail-oriented * Is flexible and willing to support different creative and marketing tasks when needed Tools You may use any tools you prefer, as long as the final result is strong. Preferred tools may include: * CapCut * Adobe Premiere Pro * After Effects * Final Cut Pro * Canva * Photoshop * AI video or image tools * Other video editing or creative platforms We do not care which tool you use. We care about the quality of the final result. ## Important This role is for someone who can think creatively and visually, not just cut clips together. Also we are a company that requires a high amount of videos. Many of our videos will still be very simple in terms of editing because we want to keep our authenticity. But we still need to make sure whenever we need more elevated and complex videos to be able to deliver . We do not need someone who only knows how to add basic captions or simple transitions. We need someone who understands visual storytelling, fashion aesthetics, ecommerce, customer behavior, and how to create videos that make a brand look stronger. Our goal is to elevate the entire visual direction of the brand. We are going through a rebrand, and we need someone who can help us create better, more stylish, more polished, and more high-converting videos than what we currently have. The right person should be able to look at fabric footage and understand how to make it feel desirable, premium, emotional, and visually interesting. This Role May Include Some days may be focused mostly on editing product videos. Other days may include creating ad videos, editing social media content, preparing campaign videos, testing different hooks, organizing footage, helping with creative concepts, or making simple motion graphics. This is not a role for someone who only wants to do one narrow type of editing. We need a creative video editor who can support different parts of the marketing process. To Apply Please send: * Your portfolio or examples of your video editing work * Examples of fashion, beauty, ecommerce, product, ad, or social media videos if you have them * Examples of short-form videos, Reels, TikToks, or ad creatives you have edited * A short message explaining why you think you are a good fit * The tools you normally use for video editing * Your experience with AI tools, motion graphics, captions, effects, or creative video editing * Your availability and preferred schedule This is a full-time position, with high Growth Potential if the person proves that she/he can bring value to our brand. We will start with 1000$/month but once the person shows they understand our vision, and gets used with the product we will increase.

description: # AI Social Media Content Creator / AI Video Creator We are looking for a driven AI Social Media Content Creator who wants to become truly excellent at creating AI-generated short-form video content. The goal of the content is to get views, engagement, and attention from the right audience for each brand. You will be working with AI tools to help create short-form videos for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, and similar platforms. This includes coming up with content ideas, writing or improving scripts, generating realistic AI images, turning those images into videos, editing the clips together, adding captions, creating hooks, and helping prepare the final video for posting. Watches training videos when provided. Double-checks their work before submitting it. Asks smart questions when something is unclear. Takes ownership of the final result. Cares about making the video better, not just “finished.” Notices small details that make AI content look fake. Understands that clean organization matters. Has integrity and tells the truth if something went wrong. Is willing to learn, improve, and work harder to create a better outcome. ## This Is A Good Fit If You Are Someone who wants to become one of the best at creating AI social media content. Creative, but also organized. Detail-oriented and willing to follow a process. Comfortable learning new AI tools. Interested in social media, short-form video, marketing, hooks, and content strategy. Willing to study what works and improve over time. Good at spotting when something looks fake, awkward, or low-quality. Able to work independently without needing to be reminded about every detail. Proud of doing work the right way. The kind of person who would rather fix something than turn in something messy. ## This Is Not A Good Fit If You Only want easy copy-and-paste tasks. Skip instructions. Turn in unfinished or sloppy work. Use AI tools without reviewing the output. Say something is done when it clearly needs more work. Do not like feedback. Get annoyed by details. This role gives you the chance to get hands-on experience creating real AI-generated content for real brands. You will learn how to think about audience psychology, hooks, content ideas, AI visuals, video structure, editing, and posting. Over time, the goal is for you to become someone who can take a content idea and turn it into a strong finished video with minimal help. ## How To Apply Please apply only if you are serious about doing high-quality work. description: GoHighLevel + Content Specialist — US Eye-Care Group Remote · Full-Time · Florida (US Eastern hours) $700–$1,100/mo base + uncapped new-patient bonuses that can double it. Read this first This is not a generic VA job. We're hiring one exceptional person to run our marketing engine — and we pay you a bonus on every new patient your work brings in. Your base is the floor. Your ceiling is set by you. If you're world-class at GoHighLevel, know US healthcare, and can create and edit scroll-stopping video and social content — keep reading. Bonus: $ per qualifying new patient (booked + shows). No cap. A strong month can out-earn your base. Paid bi-weekly via Wise — on time, every time. 13th-month bonus. Paid US holidays + leave after probation. Direct access to the CEO and marketing lead. No middle layers. Your work is seen and rewarded. We want you to out-earn your salary. That means we're both winning. About us An established US ophthalmology group with three Florida clinics, treating thousands of patients a month — senior eye health, diabetic eye disease, advanced retinal care. Real company, real budget, real tools. Not an agency, not a startup that vanishes. What you'll own GoHighLevel, end-to-end: build workflows from scratch — recall, intake, no-show recovery, review requests, referral/ambassador program. Pipelines, SMS/email sequences (copy supplied, you execute & polish), dashboards, integrations. Video & social content: film, cut, caption, and publish short-form video for Reels, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook — real doctors, staff, and patients. Warm and human. No AI avatars or AI voices — our audience is seniors and people managing a serious condition. Meta Ads support: daily Ads Manager checks, launch/duplicate creative, weekly reports. You execute under direction and must know the Health & Wellness Special Ad Category rules cold. Automation & reporting: connect the whole stack, document SOPs, send a weekly Monday snapshot to the CEO. Must-haves (don't apply without these) 2+ years hands-on GoHighLevel — workflows built from scratch, not template clicks. Proven video editing + social content — short-form that performed. Portfolio required. US healthcare / medical-practice experience — you understand our patients and what patient data can't touch (HIPAA awareness). Strong automation skills — GHL, plus Zapier / ---------- . Excellent written + spoken English, reliable 25 Mbps+ internet, webcam. Long-term mindset — we hire for years. Job-hoppers get cut early. Bonus: Meta/Google Ads experience, Canva/CapCut speed, patient recall & no-show funnels. Schedule Full-time, with live overlap 9:00 AM–2:00 PM US Eastern (9:00 PM–2:00 AM Manila), Mon–Fri for real-time work with the CEO. Rest of your hours are flexible — we measure output, not clock time. We may start you part-time with a fast path to full-time. How to apply (this is your first test) We get hundreds of applications. This filters for people who read and follow instructions. Subject line, exactly: CLEAR VISION — GHL + Content Specialist — [Your Name] In the body, in this order: Codeword "20/20" at the very top. 3 GHL workflows you built — one line each: problem + result. 2 videos/posts you created — links + results (views, saves, calls, leads). 1 Meta/Google campaign you ran — niche, spend, what you optimized, result. Years of GHL / video / ads experience. A 3-min Loom walking through one workflow inside your own GHL account. Required. Your monthly USD rate + earliest start date + US Eastern overlap you can commit to. Missing any item = automatic reject. Why you'll want this Stable US healthcare company. Real budget. Uncapped bonuses tied directly to your effort. Direct CEO access. A clear path to Operations / Marketing Manager in 12–18 months. One company, one mission, deep focus — no client-juggling. We're hiring one excellent person. Apply properly — and welcome to a role where the harder you work, the more you earn.

title: Become an E-Commerce Manager (Etsy) – Learn, Grow & Build Your Career With Us
job_title: Become an E-Commerce Manager (Etsy) – Learn, Grow & Build Your Career With Us
description: # Etsy E-Commerce Assistant (Product Research, AI & AI Design) ## We don't hire experience. We hire potential. We are looking for a motivated, creative, and analytical person who wants to build a long-term career in e-commerce. This is **not** a typical Virtual Assistant job. Our goal is to develop you into an independent Etsy E-Commerce Manager who can eventually manage an entire shop. --- # About Us We operate successful e-commerce businesses and believe in continuous learning, modern AI tools, and constant improvement. Instead of expecting years of Etsy experience, we invest in people with the right mindset. If you are curious, hardworking, and willing to learn every day, we would rather train you than hire someone with years of bad habits. --- # What You Will Do Your daily work may include: * Research profitable Etsy products and niches * Analyze competitors and identify opportunities * Create and improve product images using AI tools * Remove backgrounds and create lifestyle images * Prepare complete Etsy listings * Generate titles, descriptions, and tags with AI * Communicate with suppliers in English * Handle occasional customer messages * Suggest new ideas to improve our shops * Continuously learn and improve We don't expect you to know everything on day one. We expect you to learn quickly. --- # Paid Learning Learning is part of your job. We provide access to premium Etsy ---------- communities and learning resources. During your working hours you will: * Study new Etsy strategies * Learn AI tools * Improve your image editing skills * Stay up to date with new Etsy trends After learning something new, we expect you to think about how we can apply it to our business. --- # Who We Are Looking For You are: * Curious * Creative * Analytical * Organized * Reliable * Interested in AI * Comfortable using computers * Able to communicate in English * Interested in long-term growth Experience with Etsy is a plus, but it is **not required**. Your attitude is much more important than your experience. --- # Your Mindset We don't want someone who only follows instructions. We want someone who thinks. If you recommend a product, explain why. If you discover a better process, tell us. If you find a useful AI tool, share it. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Your ideas matter. --- # Growth & Career This is not just another job. We want to help you build a real career in e-commerce. As your skills grow, your responsibilities and income will grow too. ### Level 1 – Trainee * Learn our systems and workflows * Research products and competitors * Learn AI tools * Learn image editing * Complete paid learning through premium Etsy communities ### Level 2 – E-Commerce Assistant * Create complete Etsy listings * Edit product images * Communicate with suppliers * Handle customer support * Suggest products and improvements ### Level 3 – Shop Manager * Manage an Etsy shop independently * Find new product opportunities * Improve listings * Analyze shop performance * Make business recommendations ### Level 4 – Senior E-Commerce Manager * Improve our systems * Train new tea ---------- mbers * Develop better workflows * Take responsibility for larger projects Our goal is to help you become confident enough to manage an Etsy shop independently as quickly as possible. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for many years—not someone looking for the next short-term job. --- # Compensation During your training period, you will receive a fixed hourly rate while learning and developing your skills. After successfully completing your training, your compensation will include: * Competitive hourly pay * Performance-based bonuses * Higher earning opportunities as your responsibilities increase We believe that people who create more value should earn more. --- # Working Hours * Full-time * 40 hours per week * Monday to Friday * Long-term position --- # How to Apply Please send your application to: ---------- Please include: * Your resume (CV) * A short introduction about yourself * Why you want to work in e-commerce * Your experience with AI tools (if any) ## We want to understand how you think. Please answer the following questions: **1. Why should we hire you instead of the other applicants?** **2. Imagine you found a product on Etsy with over 5,000 sales. What would you analyze before d ---------- to sell a similar product?** **3. Tell us about one creative idea you had that improved something at work, school, or in your daily life.** **4. If you could learn one new skill to become better at this job, what would it be and why?** **5. Imagine you owned our Etsy shop for one day. What is the first thing you would improve, and why?** --- # IMPORTANT Send your application to: ---------- Use **exactly** the following email subject: ETSY APPLICATION 2026 Applications with any other subject line will be **automatically rejected**. We look forward to receiving your application and wish you the best of luck!

description: # Social Media Content Manager / Virtual Assistant for Mental Health Practice We are looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented Social Media Content Manager / Virtual Assistant to help grow the online presence of our mental health and psychiatry practice, Ravora Health. Ravora Health is a telehealth psychiatry practice focused on helping patients with anxiety, depression, ADHD, medication management, and mental wellness. We want to build a strong, trustworthy, educational, and professional brand across social media. This role is ideal for someone who understands content creation, social media growth, short-form video, Canva design, captions, scheduling, and platform-specific posting. ## Platforms We Need Help With You will help create and manage content for: * Instagram * Facebook * TikTok * X / Twitter * YouTube Shorts * Google Business Profile, preferred but not required ## Main Responsibilities You will be responsible for helping us create, organize, and publish consistent content across multiple platforms. Responsibilities may include: * Creating a weekly and monthly content calendar * Designing Instagram/Facebook graphics, carousels, quote posts, and infographics * Creating Instagram stories and story templates * Writing captions for mental health and psychiatry-related content * Creating short-form videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts * Repurposing content across Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, X, and YouTube * Creating faceless educational videos when provider video footage is not available * Using Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools * Helping generate content ideas based on mental health topics * Researching competitor content and trending healthcare/wellness content * Scheduling posts after approval * Tracking basic performance metrics * Providing a weekly content summary and recommendations ## Content Expectations We are trying to grow, so we need someone who can produce consistent content volume. We are aiming for approximately 5–9 published content touchpoints per day across all platforms. This does not mean 9 completely unique posts every day. We expect smart repurposing across platforms. For example, a single educational topic may become: * 1 Instagram carousel * 1 Facebook post * 1 X thread or several short X posts * 1 TikTok/Reel/Short * 3–5 Instagram/Facebook stories ## Weekly Minimum Deliverables At minimum, we would like help producing: * 5–7 Instagram main posts per week * 20–35 Instagram/Facebook stories per week * 5–7 Facebook posts per week * 3–5 TikToks/Reels/YouTube Shorts per week to start * 15–25 X posts per week * 3–5 YouTube Shorts per week * 1 weekly content calendar * 1 weekly performance summary * 10–20 new content ideas for future posts As we create more video content with our provider, we would like to increase short-form video production. ## Content Topics Content will focus on topics such as: * Anxiety * Depression * ADHD * Medication management * Telehealth psychiatry * Mental health education * What to expect as a new patient * Psychiatry myths * Therapy vs psychiatry * Self-care and coping skills * Appointment availability * Local New Jersey mental health content * Patient FAQs ## Important Healthcare Content Rules Because this is a healthcare practice, content must be professional, ethical, and compliant. You must not create or post: * Fake patient stories * Fake testimonials * Patient information * Screenshots of patient messages * Medical guarantees such as “we cure anxiety” or “fix ADHD fast” * Fear-based medical claims * Misleading or exaggerated health claims * Clinical advice in comments or DMs * Content copied from other creators All clinical or educational content must be reviewed and approved before publishing. ## Required Skills Please apply only if you have experience with at least some of the following: * Social media content creation * Canva * Caption writing * Content calendars * Instagram/Facebook posting * TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts * CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar video editing software * Basic social media analytics * Researching content ideas * Repurposing content across platforms * Strong written English * Reliable communication * Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines Healthcare, wellness, mental health, coaching, or professional services experience is a plus. ## Preferred Skills The ideal candidate may also have experience with: * AI content tools * AI video tools * HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Veo, CapCut, or similar tools * Google Business Profile posts * SEO-friendly social captions * Short-form video hooks * UGC-style videos * Faceless educational videos * Brand voice development ## Hours and Pay We are open to part-time support to start. Please include your hourly rate or monthly rate in your application. We are looking for someone affordable but reliable. If the work is high quality and consistent, this can grow into a long-term role. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Your social media/content creation experience 3. Examples of posts, graphics, carousels, videos, captions, or content calendars you personally created 4. Any healthcare, wellness, mental health, coaching, or professional-service content examples 5. A short explanation of your content creation process 6. A short screen-recording video showing you creating a sample post, editing a sample video, or walking through one of your previous projects 7. Your availability and preferred work schedule 8. Your expected monthly or hourly rate 9. The tools you use, such as Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, ChatGPT, etc. The screen-recording video is important. We want to make sure applicants can actually create original content and are not just copying/pasting from templates or using someone else’s portfolio. ## Paid Test Project Before hiring, we may ask selected applicants to complete a small paid test project. The test project may include: * 3 social media post ideas for Ravora Health * 1 Canva carousel * 1 short caption * 1 Instagram story set * 1 short-form video or video concept We are looking for someone who can help us build a consistent, trustworthy, warm, and professional mental health brand online.

You are comfortable learning about technology, cyber security, support services, devices, cloud systems and common customer problems. plain-English technical communication * Able to understand IT services and explain them simply * Creative with hooks, angles and content ideas * Organised enough to manage a content calendar * Commercially aware and focused on lead generation * Comfortable working with paid ads and organic content * Able to explain technical topics in simple language * Confident using social media platforms for business growth * Practical, proactive and willing to execute * Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of outcomes * Interested in growing into a broader multi-brand marketing role Required Skills and Experience The ideal candidate will have experience with: * Social media marketing * Short-form video creation * UGC content creation * Video editing * Technical writing or technology-related content creation * Experience Marketing for IT, tech, cyber security, trades, local services or professional services * Paid advertising campaign management * Meta Ads * Google Ads * Content planning * Copywriting * Lead generation campaigns * Basic website or landing page updates * Analytics and campaign reporting * Marketing products or services that require technical title: Digital Publishing and Personal Operations VA for London CEO
job_title: Digital Publishing and Personal Operations VA for London CEO
description: # Digital Publishing and Personal Operations VA for The AdTech Diary The AdTech Diary is looking for a reliable Digital Publishing and Personal Operations VA to support our London-based CEO and help make sure he is properly covered across publishing, LinkedIn, inboxes, tasks, follow-ups and day-to-day organisation. This is a remote freelance contractor role in the media/advertising sector and would suit someone based in the Philippines with experience in virtual assistance, content admin, LinkedIn support, online publishing, inbox organisation, Notion, ChatGPT and executive support. The role is part digital publishing assistant, part LinkedIn assistant and part personal operations assistant. The AdTech Diary runs a fast-moving digital publishing, content and commercial workflow across LinkedIn, Substack, Slack, Outlook, Notion, Office 365, Canva and ChatGPT. The main goal is simple: help turn ideas, messages, tasks and publishing activity into an organised system so the CEO can focus on business growth. Trust, reliability and proactivity are essential. This role involves access to private messages, unpublished content, business information and important working systems, so we need someone who is careful, discreet, dependable, caring and able to take ownership once trained. ## What this role is really about This role is about having the CEO covered. The right person will help make sure important messages are not missed, publishing tasks keep moving, follow-ups are tracked and the day-to-day noise is organised properly. You have complete permission to chase, remind, follow-up, push and organise. We need someone dependable, calm, caring and proactive. Someone who can be trusted to keep an eye on things, flag what matters and help the CEO stay ahead rather than constantly catching up. This is not just an admin role. It is a support role built around reliability, trust and ownership. The person we hire needs to be the kind of person who does what they say they will do, communicates clearly, is not afraid to ask and does not let things quietly slip. ## Main responsibilities You will support four main areas. ## Personal operations and organisation * Help organise ideas, notes, links and tasks * Turn messy notes into clear task lists * Maintain a daily priority list * Track deadlines, follow-ups and open loops * Keep a “waiting on” list updated * Help organise the CEO’s week and keep work moving * Remind the CEO of important actions that may have been missed (he is very busy) * Keep documents, spreadsheets and trackers updated * Chase basic follow-ups when instructed * Help reduce admin overload by keeping things structured * Create and maintain simple systems to organise content, tasks, ideas and follow-ups ## Digital publishing support * Format articles in Substack * Prepare LinkedIn posts for review * Upload and organise drafts * Check links, names and dates * Pull quotes and snippets from longer articles * Create simple headline options * Maintain a digital publishing calendar * Track draft, scheduled and published content * Save final published links * Organise article notes, research links and content ideas * Repurpose longer content into smaller approved assets * Update Canva templates for simple LinkedIn or newsletter visuals * Resize and organise digital content assets ## LinkedIn support * Post approved content to LinkedIn * Schedule approved LinkedIn posts when required * Monitor LinkedIn messages * Flag important LinkedIn messages * Monitor comments on posts * Track useful replies, reactions and conversations * Monitor connection requests * Flag relevant connection requests for approval * Keep a list of interesting people, companies and agencies engaging with the content * Draft simple LinkedIn replies for approval * Help organise LinkedIn content ideas and audience feedback * Save screenshots or links to useful LinkedIn activity when needed * Track published LinkedIn posts and performance notes ## Inbox and communication support * Monitor selected Slack channels * Flag important Slack messages from stakeholders and peers. * Monitor Outlook inbox and identify priority items * Prepare daily summaries of messages, email s and tasks * Draft simple replies for approval * Highlight urgent messages clearly * Summarise key conversations * Keep communication follow-ups organised ## Tool stack You must be comfortable using: * Office 365 * Outlook * Word * Excel * LinkedIn * Slack * Substack * Canva * Notion * ChatGPT You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be confident enough to use them daily, follow instructions and learn the workflow quickly. For ChatGPT, the role may involve using it to help summarise notes, organise ideas, draft simple admin replies, clean up task lists and prepare structured publishing workflows. You must still use judgement and check the output carefully. For Notion, the role will involve keeping tasks, content ideas, publishing calendars, links, drafts and follow-ups organised. For Canva, the role will mainly involve updating existing templates, resizing images, preparing simple post graphics and organising visual assets. This is not a full design role. ## Communication Communication will mainly happen through Slack, WhatsApp and Microsoft Teams. You should be comfortable using these tools daily for: * Task updates * Quick questions * Sharing links and documents * Flagging urgent items * Sending daily summaries * Joining occasional check-in calls when needed You must be responsive during agreed working hours, especially during the London time overlap. During agreed working hours, you should respond to urgent messages quickly and keep Slack, Teams or WhatsApp open. Non-urgent updates can be batched into the daily summary. ## Professional standards This is a professional support role and requires a proper home working setup. You must have: * A current CV * Valid ID for verification if requested * Very strong written and spoken English * A reliable computer or laptop * Stable high-speed internet * A quiet, professional home working environment * A working webcam and microphone * Good availability for video calls, voice notes and quick check-ins * A well-presented, professional approach to communication * The ability to join calls without background noise, interruptions or distractions You must be comfortable communicating clearly by written message, voice note and video call. This role is not suitable for someone without a reliable working setup, lots of distractions, a stable internet or a quiet place to work. ## Trust, reliability and proactivity The most important parts of this role are trust, reliability and proactivity. Tools can be learned. Processes can be taught. The right working style and attitude matters more. We need someone who can be trusted with private messages, unpublished ideas, business information and access to important tools. We need someone reliable enough that agreed tasks are done properly without constant chasing. We need someone proactive enough to spot problems, flag priorities, keep things moving and remind the CEO of things before they get missed. This is not a role for someone who waits passively for instructions every hour. After onboarding, the goal is for you to become a trusted support person who reduces pressure, brings order to the workflow and helps the CEO stay focused. ## Working style This role is designed to save time and increase head-space, not create more work or confusion. There will be onboarding, basic checklists and clear processes at the start, but over time we need someone who can work independently and manage recurring tasks and processes without being reminded every day. You should be comfortable: * Taking ownership of repeatable tasks * Following a process without constant supervision * Spotting issues before they become problems * Flagging priorities clearly * Making sensible judgement calls within agreed boundaries * Keeping the publishing and admin workflow moving * Reminding the CEO of things that may have been missed * Suggesting simple improvements to the workflow * Using ChatGPT sensibly to speed up admin, summaries and organisation * Keeping Notion clean, useful and up to date * Asking clear questions when something genuinely needs a decision The goal is for you to become a trusted support person who reduces admin, publishing and communication load. This role is not suitable for someone who needs constant daily instructions, avoids asking clear questions or waits passively for every task. ## Decision rights and approval rules At the start, most actions will need approval. Over time, once the workflow is clear and trust is built, you may be given more responsibility for repeatable tasks. You may eventually be able to do the following independently once trained: * Organise tasks, notes and links * Update Notion trackers * Prepare daily summaries * Prepare publishing drafts * Format approved content * Upload approved drafts * Track follow-ups and open loops * Save LinkedIn activity, comments and message notes * Accept clearly relevant LinkedIn connection requests if agreed * Post content that has already been approved The following will always need approval unless clearly agreed otherwise: * Sending email s * Sending Slack messages * Sending LinkedIn messages * Replying publicly on behalf of the CEO on LinkedIn * Publishing unapproved content * Editing approved content beyond formatting * Accepting unclear or sensitive LinkedIn connection requests * Rejecting important connection requests * Changing account settings * Editing the CEO’s LinkedIn profile * Deleting, archiving or moving important files, email s, posts or messages ## Important boundaries You will not send email s, Slack messages or LinkedIn messages without approval. You will not accept LinkedIn connection requests without approval unless a clear process has been agreed. You will not publish content live unless it has been approved. You will not make editorial decisions or rewrite the core voice of the content. You will not delete, archive or change important files, email s, messages or posts unless clearly instructed. You will not rely blindly on ChatGPT output. Anything created with ChatGPT must be checked for accuracy, tone and common sense before it is shared or added to the workflow. The role is about keeping the workflow organised, preparing digital content properly, managing the online publishing process and helping make sure nothing gets missed. ## Confidentiality This role involves access to private messages, unpublished content, business conversations, publishing plans, personal admin and commercial information. Confidentiality is essential. You must not share, copy, reuse, discuss or distribute any information outside the role. You must not use unpublished ideas, drafts, messages, screenshots, documents or business information for your own work or share them with anyone else. ## Security and access You may be required to use a UK-based VPN supplied by us when accessing approved work tools and accounts. This is for security, access management and consistency across platforms. You must be comfortable following access instructions carefully, including: * Using the supplied VPN when required * Keeping login details confidential * Not sharing access with anyone else * Using approved devices and accounts only * Following security instructions for LinkedIn, Outlook, Slack, Substack, Notion, Canva and other tools * Reporting any login, access or security issues immediately No personal VPNs, shared devices or password sharing. Confidentiality and trust are essential for this role. ## What success looks like Success means the CEO feels covered and supported. Important messages are flagged. Publishing work keeps moving. Follow-ups are tracked. Tasks are organised. Deadlines are visible. The inbox feels less chaotic. LinkedIn activity is monitored. Nothing important quietly disappears. The right person will bring calm, structure and reliability to a fast-moving workflow. After onboarding, the right person will help the CEO: * Keep the inbox, Slack and LinkedIn messages under control * Turn messy ideas into organised tasks * Keep publishing activity moving * Maintain a clear digital publishing calendar * Track follow-ups and open loops * Prepare approved content for publishing * Spot important messages before they get missed * Keep Notion, trackers and task lists up to date * Reduce the amount of admin sitting in the CEO’s head We need someone who can become proactive, organised and trusted once the workflow is clear. ## You should be * Very strong in written and spoken English * Very organised * Reliable * Good at summarising messages clearly * Careful with details * Professional, well-presented and confident on video calls * Able to work from a quiet, reliable home office setup * Comfortable sending voice notes and joining video calls when needed * Comfortable using Office 365, Outlook, Word, Excel, LinkedIn, Slack, Substack, Canva, Notion and ChatGPT * Confident posting approved content to LinkedIn * Able to follow clear checklists * Good at spotting important messages * Comfortable drafting simple replies for approval * Able to understand UK business communication * Able to work independently once trained * Trustworthy with confidential information * Comfortable helping organise messy ideas, notes and tasks * Calm and structured when dealing with a fast-moving workflow Experience with newsletters, content operations, LinkedIn admin, virtual assistance, inbox management, social media scheduling, Canva template updates, Notion workspaces, ChatGPT or digital publishing admin would be helpful. You do not need to be an expert in advertising technology. Attention to detail, reliability, strong English, organisation and good judgement matter more. ## Hours, pay and benefits This is a long-term freelance contractor role for the right person. Starting monthly pay: $400 USD per month Payment: paid monthly in USD Hours: 25 to 30 hours per week The role will start with a 3-month probation period. After the probation period, pay may be reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, communication, trust and ability to work independently. For the right person, this is intended to become a long-term role with The AdTech Diary. Benefits include: * Long-term remote role * Paid monthly in USD * Stable weekly hours * Regular London time overlap * Clear onboarding, systems and workflows * Supplied UK-based VPN when required * Opportunity to grow with The AdTech Diary * Potential pay increase after 3-month probation * Potential 13th month-style loyalty payment for long-term tea ---------- mbers, based on agreed terms, performance and length of service * Experience supporting a London-based CEO across publishing, LinkedIn, operations, inbox management, Notion and AI-supported workflows ## Working hours You must be available Monday to Friday with regular overlap with London working hours. Required overlap: Approximately 9am to 1pm London time, Monday to Friday but flexible. This is usually 4pm to 8pm Philippines time, or 5pm to 9pm Philippines time when the UK is on winter time. Additional hours can be completed flexibly, as long as daily tasks and deadlines are met. For 20 to 30 hours per week, the likely schedule will be either: * 20 hours per week: around 4pm to 8pm Philippines time, Monday to Friday * 25 hours per week: around 4pm to 9pm Philippines time, Monday to Friday * 30 hours per week: around 3pm to 9pm Philippines time, Monday to Friday ## Trial period and trial task The role will start with a 3-month probation period. The first step will be a paid trial task. You will be given a small set of sample tasks, including: * Organise a messy list of ideas into a clear task list * Create a simple Notion-style publishing tracker * Format one draft article for Substack * Prepare a LinkedIn post for review * Pull a few short quote snippets from a longer article * Update a simple Canva template * Review a sample inbox or message list * Review sample LinkedIn messages and connection requests * Create a short daily action summary * Update a simple publishing checklist ## Daily update format At the end of each working day, you will send a short update covering: * Urgent items * Completed tasks * Blocked tasks * Email s or messages needing review * LinkedIn activity * Publishing status * Tomorrow’s priorities * Anything you are waiting on ## How to apply Please apply with: * A copy of your CV * A short summary of your VA, digital publishing, LinkedIn or operations experience * Your availability in UK time * Confirmation that you are comfortable with $400 USD per month for 25 to 30 hours per week * Confirmation that you understand the role starts with a 3-month probation period, with potential pay review after that based on performance * Confirmation that you have valid ID if verification is requested * Confirmation that you have very strong written and spoken English * Confirmation that you have a reliable computer, stable internet and a quiet professional home working setup * Confirmation that you are comfortable with video calls, voice notes and regular check-ins * Confirmation that you are comfortable using Office 365, Outlook, Word, Excel, LinkedIn, Slack, Substack, Canva, Notion and ChatGPT * Confirmation that you are comfortable using a supplied UK-based VPN when required * Examples of similar work if you have them * A 5-bullet summary of why you would be a good fit for this role * A short answer to this question: describe a time you helped organise someone else’s messy workload, inbox, content calendar or task system. What did you do? * A short answer to this question: trust, reliability and proactivity are very important in this role. Can you give one example of a time you were trusted to manage work independently, spot issues or keep someone organised without being chased? Thank you for your time.

title: Bookkeeper / Accounts
description: Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness Engagement Part-time to start (4 hrs/day), scaling to full-time for the right person Hours Some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) preferred Reports to Business owner Software Xero (new file setup + ongoing) Start As soon as the right candidate is found About us We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling Wagyu and premium beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range. Because we have several income streams, we need someone who can keep our books clean and accurate, and show us clearly how each part of the business is performing. We are looking for one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping and tax work so we can focus on running the farm. The role You will take over all of our day-to-day bookkeeping and tax-related work. The first big job is setting up a brand-new Xero file and moving us across from our current system. After that, you keep everything reconciled, GST-coded correctly, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax. Important: all BAS and tax documents are reviewed and signed off by the owner before lodgement. You prepare; we approve. What you will do • Set up a brand-new Xero file from scratch and manage the changeover from our current system — chart of accounts, opening balances, bank feeds and contacts. • Structure the accounts so each income stream (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) can be reported separately for both income and expenses — using Xero tracking categories. • Process and reconcile all bank transactions across multiple accounts. • Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim back. You apply the right GST code to every transaction. • Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting tax documents for the owner to review and lodge. • Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking. • Maintain accurate records for end-of-year tax and liaise with our Australian accountant when needed. • Flag any errors, odd transactions or discrepancies early. We value someone who flags problems rather than hiding them. Must have • Solid hands-on experience setting up and running Xero (Xero certification / ProAdvisor is a strong plus). • Good understanding of GST and the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases — or a strong tax background and the ability to learn the Australian system quickly. • A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses. • Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed. • Reliable internet, your own computer, and good written English. • Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information. Nice to have • Experience with Australian clients, BAS preparation, or the Australian tax system. • Experience with multi-enterprise, farming or primary-production accounts. • Confidence using Xero tracking categories for departmental / enterprise reporting. Why work with us • Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility. • Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry. • A friendly, straightforward team that values accuracy and clear communication. How to apply To apply, please send the following. Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it tells us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. 1. Your CV / resume. 2. A short note on your Xero experience and whether you are Xero-certified. 3. Your experience (if any) with Australian tax / GST / BAS. 4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available. Please also answer these three quick questions in your application: • In Xero, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business? (One or two sentences is fine.) • If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books? • Have you prepared a BAS before, or worked with Australian GST? If not, how comfortable are you learning a new tax system? Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: Airtable Specialist & Systems Builder
description: ABOUT RELATIONAL MINDS Relational Minds is an Australian child and family mental health organisation delivering relationship-focused, evidence-informed programs to parents, children, educators, and leaders. Our philosophy is grounded in relationship-first approaches, compassionate communication, and trauma-informed, evidence-based practice. THE OPERATIONAL CONTEXT We coordinate complex assessment and treatment pathways involving multiple clinicians and strict timelines. Our Family Experience Team ensures every family's journey is organised, visible, and followed through. We are transitioning from spreadsheet-based tracking to a modern relationship management system built on Airtable. Airtable will be our central system for managing family journeys, lifecycle stages, and service coordination, connected to our practice management system so family and appointment data flows through automatically. You will be the person who builds it, connects it, and looks after it. THE ROLE You will be our Airtable specialist and the technical backbone of our Customer Experience team. The role has three core parts. First, you will design and build our Airtable system from the ground up so it maps our family journey and keeps every family organised, visible, and on schedule. Second, you will build and own the connection between our practice management system, Halaxy, and Airtable, using Halaxy's API so that family and appointment information syncs across automatically and nothing has to be entered twice. Third, you will teach our Customer Experience team to use the system confidently, so it becomes something the whole team relies on rather than something only you understand. This is a long-term, senior role. Once the system is live, you do not step back. You stay on as a senior member of the CX team and the technical partner to the Customer Experience Manager: keeping the system healthy, improving it as we grow, maintaining the integration, and helping coordinate the family journey within it. You will be the person the team turns to when they need the system to do something new. You will report to the Customer Experience Manager and work alongside them as their technical counterpart. WHY WORK WITH US • Values: We value kindness, clarity, and reliable teamwork. • Culture: We offer a calm, respectful, emotionally intelligent work environment. • Leadership: You will work with supportive Australian leadership that values initiative and good judgement. • Growth: This is a meaningful long-term role where you will help shape how our systems evolve as the organisation grows. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Build and configure the Airtable system Design and set up our bases, tables, linked records, views, interfaces, and automations to map the family journey from intake through assessment, treatment blocks, and follow-up. • Build and own the Halaxy integration Connect Halaxy to Airtable through Halaxy's API (directly or via a tool such as Make), so family and appointment data syncs automatically. Own this integration on an ongoing basis, monitoring it and fixing it when it needs attention. • Train and enable the CX team Teach the team to use the system confidently, create clear written guides, and provide ongoing support as the system evolves. • Maintain data integrity Keep Airtable as the central "source of truth" for family records, service stages, and communication history, and keep it in sync with Halaxy. • Improve the system over time Refine fields, views, tags, linked records, automations, and the integration so the team can always see where attention is needed. • Coordinate the family journey Track each family's progress, monitor clinician and administrative timelines, and follow up when deadlines are approaching or overdue. • Risk identification Identify delays, missing information, or stalled cases and escalate to the Customer Experience Manager. • Documentation coordination Ensure consents, reports, and key documents are correctly linked and stored within our Microsoft 365 environment. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE • Airtable build experience (essential) Proven experience designing and building Airtable systems, not just using them: bases, tables, linked records, views, interfaces, and automations. You should be comfortable building a system from scratch. • API integration experience (essential) Demonstrated experience connecting two systems through an API, whether directly or through a tool such as Make, Zapier, or n8n. You will be building and maintaining the link between Halaxy and Airtable, so this is core to the role. • Ability to teach and explain (essential) Excellent spoken and written English, with a demonstrated ability to train non-technical teams and explain systems clearly, patiently, and simply. You will be teaching our team, so this is not optional. • Structured data management Experience maintaining accurate records and ensuring systems stay clean and reliable. • Responsible handling of sensitive data Awareness of how to handle confidential information carefully. You will be working with health-related data, so discretion and good judgement matter. • Experience working with Australian companies Understanding of Australian professional expectations and communication style. HIGHLY REGARDED • Experience in Australian healthcare, allied health, or NDIS-related services • Experience integrating with practice management or health systems, or with FHIR-based APIs • Experience implementing database or CRM systems during organisational growth • Background in operations coordination, client success, or service delivery WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT • Not a general Virtual Assistant role • Not a passive data-entry position • Not a call centre role You will build the system, connect it to Halaxy, teach the team, and stay on as the senior technical partner who keeps it all running. WORK DETAILS • Remote position (work from home) • Full-time, long-term role • Work aligned with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) business hours • Direct collaboration with an Australian leadership team HOW TO APPLY Please include in your application: • A summary of Airtable systems you have built, ideally with a link or screenshots of a base you designed • An example of an integration you have built between two systems, what tools you used, and how you kept it reliable • An example of a time you taught a team or an individual to use a system, and how you made it easy for them • Your experience working with Australian companies Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical task: build a simple client-journey base in Airtable and record a brief walkthrough explaining how it works and how you would approach connecting it to another system through an API. This lets us see your build skill, your integration thinking, and your ability to teach, all at once. ---

job_title: Real Estate Data Manager (YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH)
description: * YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH * We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction. 2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM. 3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format 4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing 5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status) 6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1 7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage 8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.) A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch. Tools You'll Use: - Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP) - FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you) - XLeads (skip tracing) - Trestle (phone verification) - County government websites (varies by list type) - Slack (daily check-ins and questions) What We Need From You: - Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting - Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money - Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs - Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace - Good written English for daily Slack updates - Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team) - Able to start As Soon As Possible Bonus Points If You Have: - Prior US real estate experience - Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM - Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles - Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.) - Familiarity with US county records systems What Makes This Role Different: - Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week. - Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday. - Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role. You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach. How to Apply 1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread. 2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took. 3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time. 4. Your job is what happens after a post goes live — and in 2026, that's the single biggest driver of growth: fast, real, human engagement in the first hour. In the ~15 minutes before our Reels go live, prime each account — reply to recent comments and leave a few genuine comments on accounts in our niche — so each post drops into an already-active feed. This pre-post warm-up is part of the daily rhythm, not optional. Work the live window. The ---------- nt our Reels go live, you're there — replying to every comment and like, and starting real conversations across our Instagram and Facebook accounts. The first 60–90 minutes after each post is the priority. Manage DMs across all accounts — answer questions, welcome new followers, route anything important to the manager. Outbound engagement — genuinely engage in pet-focused communities and on creator accounts in our niche (thoughtful comments, not spam) to grow our presence. Keep our voice — every reply sounds like the brand: warm, a little elevated, pets-as-family. We'll give you brand-voice tools that make this fast and consistent (full training provided). Log your work daily via a simple Google Form. THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying) Our posts go live in the evening US time, which is morning your time. This is when content goes live, and engagement matters most. Plus a short follow-up window later in your morning, and flexible hours for outbound, DMs, and planning. title: Finance Deal / Engagement Manager

A company hires us when they need funding, and we connect them to investors (mostly large investors in the Gulf region) and guide the whole process until they get the investment. The role When a company hires us, there's a full process to get them their funding: preparing documents, getting them in front of the right investors, and guiding the deal until an investment is agreed. You're the person who keeps that whole process organized and moving for each company we work with, so nothing gets stuck and deals actually get done. You don't need to have done this exact job before. If you're extremely organized, good with people, and the kind of person who chases things until they're finished, we'll teach you the rest. We create things like a short "teaser" and a longer "investment memo" (documents that present the company to investors) and a financial spreadsheet showing the numbers. Our analysts build these - your job is to make sure they're done on time and done well - Get the company in front of investors. You'll work with our investor team to make sure each company is shown to the right investors, and that investor questions get answered - Stay in touch with the company (our client). Keep them updated, answer their questions, and make sure they send us what we need on time - Chase everything. Follow up with the team, the client, and the investors so nothing gets forgotten or stuck. This is most of the job - keeping things moving - Handle the paperwork. Make sure agreements (like confidentiality agreements and contracts) get sent and signed - Keep pushing until the deal is done - until an investment is agreed and the money comes in. That's the goal you're working toward on every deal What we're looking for - Incredibly organized - you like lists, tracking, and keeping things in order, and you never lose track of what's outstanding - A great communicator - comfortable email ing and speaking with clients and the team in a professional way - A finisher - you chase things until they're done and don't let them slip - Reliable and proactive - you take initiative instead of waiting to be told
