title: Appointment Setter
description: Financial Literacy Basics FINANCIAL PLANNERS Position: Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative Location Remote — Work From Anywhere Employment Type Independent Contractor (1099) Daily Activity Standard Minimum 100 dials per day — Target 100–300 with power dialer Contact Goal 20–30 live prospect conversations per day Compensation Monthly Retainer + Per Qualified Appointment Bonus Reports To Lead Financial Planner, Financial Literacy Basics Start Date Immediate ABOUT Financial Literacy Basics Financial Literacy Basics is a financial planning and education firm operating under the financial planning and education brand. We design retirement and wealth plans built to last — plans grounded in structural analysis, real math, and risks most advisors never address. We work with people at every stage of their financial journey who want to make sure their money is working as hard as they are. We are not a traditional financial advisory/planning firm. We are plan architectural engineers. Our work identifies the gaps, the blind spots, and the structural weaknesses in a client's current approach — and we build the framework to fix them. THE ROLE We are looking for motivated, self-directed individuals to join Financial Literacy Basics as Appointment Setters. Your role has two clear objectives: connect with prospective clients by phone, schedule a 20-minute discovery call with our lead planner, and collect basic financial profile data so the architect can make the most of that conversation. You do not need a financial background. You do not need sales experience. You need confidence on the phone, the discipline to make calls consistently, and the professionalism to represent the Financial Literacy Basics brand with integrity. This is a door-opening role. You are the first impression and the intake point. Your success is measured by two things: qualified appointments booked and prospect data collected accurately. RESPONSIBILITIES • Make outbound cold calls to prospective clients using a provided script and contact list • Deliver the Financial Literacy Basics opening script with consistency, confidence, and professionalism • Handle common objections using trained responses and redirect to appointment booking • Schedule 20-minute discovery calls between prospects and the Financial Literacy Basics lead architect • Collect basic financial profile data from each booked prospect — years to retirement, investable asset range, advisor status, and primary financial concern • Submit completed prospect data forms to the lead architect prior to each scheduled call • Leave professional voi cemail s and follow up with prospects on callback commitments • Log all call activity daily — dials, contacts, outcomes, appointments booked, and data collected • Maintain a minimum of 100 dials per day; target 100–300 using power dialer tools • Participate in brief weekly check-in calls to review performance and refine approach WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This is strictly an appointment-setting and data collection role. You are not expected to discuss financial strategy, investment products, market conditions, or any aspect of retirement planning. If a prospect asks detailed financial questions, your response is: "That's exactly what the call is for — I'll let our lead architect walk you through it." • You will NOT provide financial advice or discuss investment strategies • You will NOT present or explain the Financial Literacy Basics plan methodology • You will NOT represent yourself as a financial advisor or planner • You will NOT make promises about outcomes, returns, or specific plan recommendations • You will NOT discuss fees or pricing — that is handled by the lead architect DATA COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY Once a prospect agrees to a call and confirms their email , you will collect four data points before ending the conversation. This takes approximately 60 seconds and is framed as helping the planner prepare — which it does. Data Point Why It Matters Years to Retirement Determines planning horizon and urgency — shapes the entire architecture framework Has a Financial Advisor? Sets context for how the discovery call is framed — additive vs. first-time planning Investable Asset Range Establishes whether the prospect is qualified and helps architect tailor the conversation Primary Financial Concern Market risk, income, inflation, or legacy — allows architect to lead with what matters most to them If a prospect declines to answer, do not push. Note it as "declined" and move on. The appointment is always the priority — data collection is secondary. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required • Comfortable and confident speaking on the phone with strangers • Self-motivated — able to work independently without daily supervision • Disciplined — able to maintain 50+ dials per day consistently • Detail-oriented — able to accurately capture and submit prospect data after each booking • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment • Basic computer skills — email , calendar scheduling, simple spreadsheets or forms • Professional demeanor and clear verbal communication Preferred (Not Required) • Prior experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or phone-based sales • Background in insurance, annuities, or any financial services outreach • Experience using a CRM or power dialer platform (CloudTalk, HubSpot, etc.) • Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive, consistent approach COMPENSATION STRUCTURE Trial Period: Week 1 and 2:  $35 per qualified appointment — no retainer Week 3 and 4: $40 per qualified appointment — no retainer Continuous Offer: Monthly Retainer $1000 – $3000 (based on performance, experience and availability) + $35-$40  per qualified appointment Per Qualified Appointment Bonus paid per appointment that is confirmed, shows, and includes collected data Definition of Qualified Prospect confirmed the call, provided contact info, attended the 20-minute discovery call, and basic data was collected prior Payment Schedule Monthly — net 15 following the close of the calendar month Classification Independent Contractor — 1099 issued annually Compensation details are finalized during the offer conversation. High performers who demonstrate consistency, data accuracy, and brand alignment will be considered for advancement with expanded responsibilities and increased earning potential. GROWTH PATH Financial Literacy Basics is building a distribution network. This role is the entry point. Strong performers advance through three stages — all based on performance, not time. 1 Appointment Setter Script-driven outreach. Book the call. Collect prospect data. Nothing more. 2 Junior Financial Planner Learn the Financial Literacy Basics language and methodology firsthand.  Learn basic financial planning and budgeting. 3 Senior Financial Planner Present the plan framework to prospects with architect support. Expanded compensation and responsibility. HOW TO APPLY Send a brief introduction — no resume required — that answers the following three questions: • Tell us about a time you had to persuade someone or handle pushback in a conversation. • What does your current daily schedule look like and how many hours can you commit to this role? • Have you ever made cold calls or done phone-based outreach? If yes, describe the context. Submit to: ---------- with subject line: "Financial Literacy Basics — Appointment Setter"

title: Sales Development Representative (High-Ticket Appointment Setter)
description: About the role Tres Client Acquisition Pte Ltd is a business education and advisory company serving founders and business owners across Singapore and Malaysia. We generate a steady flow of inbound leads and buyers, and we're looking for a sharp, experienced Sales Development Representative to own the first conversation, qualify the right people, and get them booked (and showing up) for calls with our closing team. This is not an entry-level dialling job. You'll be the front line of our sales engine, and the quality of every booked call runs through you. What you'll do: - *Inbound speed-to-lead.* Call new inbound leads within 60 seconds of opt-in, qualify them, and book them onto a closer's calendar. - *Qualify self-booked leads.* Vet people who've already booked a call to confirm they're a genuine fit before they reach a closer. - *Lift show rates.* Run confirmation and reminder sequences, and recover no-shows and cancellations back onto the calendar. - *Reactivate the database.* Call and warm up aged leads, re-open the conversation, and set appointments. - *Recover abandoned carts.* Call people who started but didn't complete a purchase. - *Drive event attendance.* Call to fill our low-ticket events, and follow up with attendees afterwards to set calls. - *Work every channel.* Phone and Zoom first, plus WhatsApp, SMS, and email in a structured multi-touch cadence. - *Keep the engine clean.* Log every call and outcome in GoHighLevel, and write a clear handoff brief (problem, numbers, goal) for the closer on every booked call. What we're looking for: - *2–3+ years in high-ticket sales* — as an appointment setter, SDR, or closer. Experience selling or setting for coaching, consulting, or info-product offers is a strong advantage; experience as a closer is a big plus. - *Exceptional spoken English.* Fluent, clear, and neutral — your English should sound polished and professional to a Singapore and Southeast Asian business audience, with no strong regional accent. Comfortable with Singapore/British English conventions rather than heavy American slang. (We'll assess this through your application video — see "How to apply.") - *A real phone and Zoom operator.* Confident on the phone and on camera, calm under objections, and skilled at consultative, question-led conversations. You build trust fast and you don't sound scripted. - *Disciplined and coachable.* You log your work, hit your activity targets, and act on call-review feedback. - *Properly set up to work from home.* A quiet, professional environment, a reliable high-speed internet connection with a backup, a good headset, a webcam, and a capable computer. - *Able to work Singapore business hours (GMT+8)* — which is your timezone, so no night shifts. Nice to have: - Familiarity with GoHighLevel (or a similar CRM), a power/auto-dialler, and WhatsApp Business. - Experience reactivating cold databases or running outbound campaigns. - A track record you can point to (set rates, show rates, or deals influenced). What success looks like (first 90 days): - Consistently dialling inbound leads inside 60 seconds. - Hitting target connect, set, and show rates on qualified conversations. - Clean CRM hygiene and closer briefs on every booked call. Compensation: - *Base: SGD $800–$1,200/month*, depending on experience. - *Plus a per-show bonus* for every qualified call that actually attends. - (Optional, recommended to attract top talent: a small commission on deals closed from the calls you set — this is what turns a good SDR into a motivated one and helps land an ex-closer.) - Paid in Singapore Dollars, monthly via bank transfer. How to apply: We're not interested in a traditional CV. Instead, send us two things: 1. A short presentation (slides or a document) covering: - What you sold, and who you sold it to. - Why the offer was good — why people bought. - The results you helped your customers or clients achieve. - Your specific role in the sales process. - The results you brought the company (give real numbers). - Why you believe your experience will help TRES specifically. 2. A short video selling yourself to us. Treat us as the prospect and convince us you're the right person for this role. This is how we assess your spoken English, your presence, and your ability to actually sell — so make it count. Numbers 1 & 2 can be uploaded to this form: ----------

title: SEO Specialist | Content Driven
description: ## The role in one line You lead SEO for a small portfolio of clients and own what we deliver to them: strategy, on-page, content and links. You set the direction for each campaign and ensure the work that goes out is genuinely good. ## We are a small agency, and that is the point We are small on purpose and growing steadily, so read the responsibilities below in that light. You would lead fewer than 10 active campaigns, and they would be small in scope, not sprawling enterprise accounts. We cap how much any one person carries: before the work piles up, we bring in more people to support the other parts of a campaign. You are also free to bring in copywriters and link-building contractors, and to manage them. So, while the list below may look broad, you are not doing all of it alone or at scale. You lead the campaigns, set the standard, and pull in support where it helps. We also have someone who handles technical SEO, so that is not on your plate day-to-day. ## Who you would be working for We are part of Lakewood media, a UK agency going since 2013. We care about more than rankings. The wider mission is to do excellent digital work for purpose-driven businesses while giving something back, including a commitment to plant 1,000 trees by 2027 and a focus on the communities we work in across the UK, the Philippines and South Africa. We are aiming to become one of the top premium UK digital agencies, and we want the people who help get us there to grow with us. ## How we work, and why you would want to We are a small, distributed team, and we are genuinely flexible. - Work the hours that suit you. Your working day is largely yours to shape. - Your location does not matter to us. Work from wherever you are. - The only fixed ask is that you are available for the handful of meetings we schedule. - We judge the work by its outputs, not by hours logged. - You would be part of a small team where your opinion, expertise and time are genuinely valued. ## What makes this role different Most of our current work sits inside one niche: high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. This is under our agency HauteLab. You will start there, across our full client roster, and learn that world by working in it. Within roughly the next 6-12 months, you will also take on clients for our sister brand, Peak Narrative, which operates in very different sectors: education, the environment, and outdoor lifestyle. The delivery model is the same. The niches are not. That is why we care far more about strong, current SEO fundamentals than about niche experience. Good SEO works in any niche. We can quickly hand you the context for a sector, we cannot teach sound judgment as quickly. If you understand why something ranks, you will be effective whether the page is about an escort agency or a private school. ## What you will own - Lead every SEO campaign in your portfolio: set the strategy, priorities and roadmap, and keep each one moving - Own the deliverables. You build the monthly deliverable reports and bring them to Adam, who stays the client's primary point of contact and runs the live monthly reviews - Plan content strategy for each client, oversee content creation (your own and your writers'), and edit to a high standard - Run link building at the small scale these clients need, bringing in and managing link contractors to help - Hire and manage copywriters and freelancers where it helps: brief them, review their work, keep them on time and on standard - Keep the client workbooks accurate and delivery on cadence ## The SEO expertise we need We want an all-out SEO expert, someone whose judgment we can trust on any campaign. Specifically, deep command of: - On-page SEO, inside out: titles, headings, internal linking, structured data and content quality, all matched to user intent rather than a word count. - Content strategy: planning topic clusters and the pieces that actually move rankings, not filler or generic AI nonsense. **We are looking for someone with ‘outside the box’ thinking that can work with clients to build unique content angles.** - Trust and E-E-A-T as a site-wide signal: about pages, author and trust signals, and non-commodity content that earns its place. - Current SEO strategy: people-first content as the baseline (the Helpful Content System is now part of core ranking), and a clear-eyed view of AI search. AI Overviews and AI Mode run on the same systems as classic search, so doing real SEO covers both. We do not chase "AEO" or "GEO" gimmicks. - The value of links and how to build them at small scale: quality over quantity, a real grasp of anchor distribution, velocity and source diversity, and the judgment to win a few strong links rather than many weak ones. - Understanding how to us AI tools to during this process is critical. For example using Claude Code to build tailored targets for outreach and push them into a cold outreach campaign on Smartlead. ## Tools and data - SEO and analytics: strong working mastery of Ahrefs, Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4. - Site audits: you do not have to be our deep technical person, we have someone who handles technical SEO. But when an Ahrefs or Screaming Frog audit flags issues, you need to read it, know which on-page problems matter, and either fix them yourself or direct how they should be fixed. - AI as a force multiplier: a real part of how we work, covered in its own section below. Deep knowledge of Claude using Cowork, Code and skills. - Our stack: Asana (project management), Notion (knowledge base), Missive (email and comms), Pipedrive (sales), Google Workspace and WordPress for sites we build and manage. ## Working with AI (a big part of how we operate) We lean on AI to keep quality high and delivery efficient, so using it well genuinely matters here. We do test for it, because it is part of the job, not a bolt-on. We are not looking for someone who pastes a prompt into Claude and copies the answer back out. We want someone who builds AI into the work to lift the quality and the speed of the end result. In practice that means: - Using Claude on real, multi-step tasks, not one-off questions - Building repeatable workflows with connectors and skills. For example: pull a Screaming Frog crawl or a GSC via Composio connector, break it down, cross-reference it against Ahrefs, then turn it into a clear, prioritised report a client can read in plain English - Being able to maintain and use more advanced setups, not just chat. Cowork and Code for long complex tasks. Building skills and updating existing to make processes and workflows more efficient. - Knowing the line between augmenting your judgment and outsourcing it. AI improves the output; it does not produce the deliverable unsupervised Done well, this is how one person handles more clients without the quality dropping. It is central to how we operate. ## Attention to detail and organisation (non-negotiable) You will hold many moving parts across several clients at once: content stages, link logs, reporting deadlines, vendor spend and workbook hygiene. Small errors compound fast across a portfolio. We need someone genuinely meticulous and well organised, who keeps trackers accurate, follows a process and does not let things slip. This is a hard requirement, and the assessment is built to surface whether you have it. ## What a typical week looks like This is built from the real work the role carries today, not a generic list. **Content** - Plan the month's content for each client and brief the freelance writers (when needed) - Write and edit blog posts, landing pages, city and category pages, and client profile pages - Review writers' drafts against the brief and our human-first standard before anything goes live **Links** - Own each client's link plan, build links at the small scale they need, and use contractors to help with outreach and placements - Vet and rate links from vendors, find and buy relevant expired domains, and log every live link in the workbook **Technical and analysis** - Review Ahrefs and Screaming Frog site audits and turn the findings into a prioritised on-page action list (our technical specialist handles the heavy technical fixes) - Check Search Console for discovered-but-not-indexed content and track stage keywords in Ahrefs - Run competitor and link-gap analysis, on-page audits and trust or about-page builds **Reporting and admin** - Produce end-of-month deliverables summaries per client and set up the next month's content stages - Keep workbooks clean (stage IDs, content planner, live links), document decisions in the client wiki, and stay on top of client email ## Being upfront about the niche We specialise in high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. We are completely transparent about this from the start, because we know it is not for everyone. The work itself is standard SEO and content delivery. If you are not comfortable working in this sector, this is not the right role, and that is fine. We would rather you know now than later. ## Who this is for - A genuine SEO expert who can lead campaigns and own delivery without hand-holding - Deep on content, on-page, E-E-A-T and links (technical depth is a bonus, not a must, we have that covered) - Genuinely fluent with AI as a working tool, not a novelty - Meticulous, organised and reliable on deadlines - Comfortable in the adult niche, able to flex into other sectors, and keen to grow with us long term ## Who it is not for - Specialists who only do one slice of SEO and cannot lead a whole campaign - Anyone who needs a fixed playbook and struggles when the niche changes - "AI users" whose skill stops at pasting prompts - Anyone who needs AI to understand the work they are doing. ## Where this role can go This is not a seat to fill and forget. We are growing, and we want the person we bring in now to grow with us and become a key part of the agency. As we add clients, you would lead a bigger share of delivery and bring people in under you rather than just carry more yourself. The rate is a starting point, and we expect it to rise as you take on more and as we grow. If you want somewhere to do excellent work and build something over the next few years, this is it.

title: Virtual Assisstant
description: Company: Ottawa Prime Properties Location: Remote Languages: English and French Job Type: Full-time or Part-time About Ottawa Prime Properties Ottawa Prime Properties is a growing property management company serving residential and commercial properties in Ontario and Quebec. We are looking for a highly organized, bilingual Virtual Assistant with property management experience to support our daily operations, tenant communication, maintenance coordination, leasing administration, and owner/client reporting. Position Overview The Bilingual Virtual Assistant will provide administrative and operational support to the property management team. The ideal candidate must be fluent in English and French, have strong communication skills, and understand property management procedures in both Ontario and Quebec, including tenant notices, leases, rent collection, maintenance follow-ups, and documentation. Experience with Ontario’s Landlord and Tenant Board processes and Quebec’s Tribunal administratif du logement procedures is a strong asset, especially for preparing notices, tracking files, and supporting landlord-tenant documentation. The TAL handles lease-related matters such as rent increases, repossessions, and landlord/tenant disputes, while Ontario’s Residential Tenancies Act provides the framework for residential tenancies, including rent increases and evictions. Key Responsibilities The Bilingual Virtual Assistant will be responsible for: Managing daily email communication with tenants, owners, contractors, and team members in both English and French. Answering tenant inquiries professionally and escalating urgent matters to the property manager. Coordinating maintenance requests, following up with contractors, requesting quotes, and updating tenants and owners. Preparing and sending notices, letters, reminders, and property-related communications in English and French. Assisting with lease administration, renewals, rent increase notices, tenant onboarding, and move-in/move-out coordination. Updating property management software with tenant information, charges, maintenance notes, lease details, documents, and communication records. Following up on unpaid rent, payment confirmations, utility bills, invoices, and owner-related accounting requests. Organizing documents, invoices, quotes, inspection photos, reports, and property files. Assisting with leasing tasks, including responding to rental inquiries, scheduling showings, screening applicants, collecting documents, and preparing lease files. Tracking deadlines for renewals, notices, maintenance work, inspections, and tenant requests. Supporting Ontario and Quebec property-management workflows, including LTB/TAL-related documents and timelines. Preparing clear summaries and updates for management, owners, and internal meetings. Required Qualifications Fluent in English and French, written and spoken. Previous experience as a virtual assistant, administrative assistant, property management assistant, or leasing coordinator. Property management experience in Ontario and Quebec is strongly preferred. Knowledge of residential leases, tenant notices, rent collection, maintenance coordination, and tenant communication. Familiarity with Ontario LTB and Quebec TAL processes is a strong asset. Strong writing skills and ability to prepare professional email s, notices, and reports. Excellent organization, follow-up, and time-management skills. Comfortable working remotely and independently. Strong attention to detail and ability to document all communication properly. Ability to handle tenant issues professionally and calmly. Experience using property management software such as Buildium, AppFolio, DoorLoop, Yardi, or similar is an asset. Proficient with Google Drive, Gmail, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and DocuSign. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and priorities at the same time. They must be able to communicate professionally with tenants, owners, contractors, and team members while keeping accurate records of every request and follow-up. This person should understand that property management requires strong documentation, fast follow-up, and clear communication, especially when dealing with maintenance, rent collection, lease renewals, tenant complaints, and legal notices. Work Schedule Remote position. Monday to Friday availability preferred. Occasional urgent follow-ups may be required depending on tenant or maintenance issues. Ontario and Quebec business-hour availability is preferred. How to Apply Please send your resume and a short message explaining your property management experience in Ontario and Quebec, your level of English and French, and any property management software you have used. Subject line: Bilingual Virtual Assistant – Property Management Application Short Version for Job Posting Ottawa Prime Properties is hiring a bilingual Virtual Assistant with property management experience in Ontario and Quebec. The role includes tenant communication, maintenance coordination, lease administration, rent follow-ups, notices, document organization, contractor coordination, and support with LTB/TAL-related property management tasks. The ideal candidate must be fluent in English and French, highly organized, experienced in property management, and comfortable working remotely with tenants, owners, contractors, and internal team members.

title: B2B Cold Caller
description: We're hiring an experienced cold caller to book 15-30 minute discovery calls with home service business owners (garage door repair, tree trimmers, spas) for our AI voice agent. The offer is straightforward, the pain is real, and the script works. You dial, you book, you log, you move on. About the offer: We sell an AI voice agent that answers every inbound call 24/7 for home service businesses. The AI qualifies the lead, answers common questions, and books the job directly into the business owner's calendar. The pitch is simple: "You're losing X calls a month to voi cemail , our AI answers all of them and books them straight into your calendar." High-ROI, easy to demo, and the pain is universal in this vertical. What you'll be doing: - Cold calling home service business owners from a pre-qualified list I'll provide - Following a proven call script and objection handling guide (you don't write it) - Qualifying prospects and booking 15-30 minute discovery calls onto our calendar - Logging call outcomes and notes in our CRM after every call - Reporting daily on dials, conversations, and calls booked What we provide: - Full lead list (you do not source unless its a personal advantage to help you with outreach) - Proven call script and objection handling guide - Daily targets and clear performance metrics You're a fit if: - 1+ year of B2B cold calling (services, SaaS, agency, or similar) - Native or near-native English with a neutral US accent - Experience calling blue collar or home service businesses is a strong plus - Comfortable dialing 40-60 numbers per hour - Thick skin — you can take rejection and keep your tone clean on the next call - Available during US business hours (Eastern or Central preferred) - Reliable internet, headset, and a quiet space - Door-to-door sales experience is optional but great experience to have You're not a fit if: - Your background is consumer telemarketing or solar - You want to "consult on strategy" — this role is execution, not advisory - You can't commit to consistent weekly hours (we need predictable dial volume) - You won't follow a script (you can suggest changes, but the script is the script until we update it together) Compensation: - $10/hour base - 20 hours/week during the 1-week paid trial - Continued hourly + bonus per booked call that shows up to the discovery call after the trial (if it goes well) - Trial terms 1-week paid trial (20 hours): - To extend past the trial: book at least 3 discovery calls that actually show up by end of week - If we don't hit the threshold, the trial ends and we part as friends — no long-term commitment either way - To apply (applications missing any of these will not be reviewed) A 45-60 second voice recording reading the sample opener and pitch below. Read it like you're actually making the call, not like you're reading aloud. Sample opener: "Hi, this is [name] calling from Good AiDeas. The reason for my call is we're working with garage door companies across the US, and we've been finding that most of them are losing 20-30 calls a month to voi cemail and afterhours calls not being picked up or returned. We built an AI receptionist that answers those calls 24/7 and books the job straight into the your team's calendar. Do you have 60 seconds for me to explain how it works?" Sample pitch (1-2 sentences): "It's a voice AI receptionist. Not a chatbot. It sounds like a real person, takes the caller's info, qualifies the job, and books it. It costs a fraction of a receptionist and never sleeps. Most of our customers are booking 10-20 extra jobs a month within the first 30 days." And in one sentence: who did you call in your last cold calling role, what were you booking, and what was your booking rate (per hour, per day, or per week. Provide your hourly rate and weekly availability. Confirm your time zone and that you can work US business hours. I'm in the US EST (New York) timezone.

title: Patient Support Representative (Medical Customer Service)
description: About Us We’re building a global talent pool of exceptional remote Patient Support professionals to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare, often combining general practice with wellness, integrative, and allied health support. Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—calm, clear, patient-first support that improves access, continuity of care, and measurable outcomes. If you’re empathetic, detail-oriented, and thrive in structured remote work, we’d love to meet you. Role Overview As a Patient Support Representative (Medical Customer Service), you’ll be the friendly and professional bridge between patients, clinicians, and care teams—helping patients move smoothly from first contact, intake, booking, and follow-up. This is a pooling/talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to open roles with clinics based on: - Your experience (clinical/admin) - Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US) - Tools you’ve used (EMR/CRM/VoIP) - Compensation alignment and scope What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) - Provide patient support via phone, email , SMS, and chat with a calm, empathetic tone. - Manage shared inboxes/queues and ensure timely updates (no one gets left waiting). - Coordinate appointments: scheduling, confirmations, reminders, and troubleshooting. - Assist patients with onboarding steps: intake forms, consent, health summaries, and identity checks (per clinic policy). - Maintain accurate patient records and documentation in EMR/EHR/CRM systems. - Support clinicians with administrative tasks that keep consults on track (handoffs, notes, follow-up tasks). - Handle prescription-related requests only within clinic policy (e.g., routing refill requests, coordinating with pharmacies). - Coordinate with pharmacies when required (scripts, transfers, stock checks) and flag urgent concerns. - Support compliance-minded workflows (documentation completeness, required forms, audit-friendly notes). - Handle complaints and sensitive situations professionally; use de-escalation skills and escalation pathways. - Work closely with an international team across time zones using async updates and clear handoffs. - Protect patient privacy and confidentiality at all times. Must-Have Qualifications - 2+ years in a patient-facing role in healthcare support, clinic admin, or medical customer service. - Strong spoken and written English (confident with international patients). - Excellent communication skills: warm, clear, patient, and non-judgmental. - High attention to detail and comfort with structured documentation. - Able to multitask across patient support + scheduling + admin without losing accuracy. - Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and proactive communication. - Comfortable learning new tools quickly (EHR/EMR, CRM, scheduling, VoIP). - Reliable home setup: quiet private workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan. - Willingness to work shifts that overlap with AU/UK/US/NZ clinic hours depending on assignment. Note: Some matched roles may prefer a clinical background (e.g., Nursing graduate). Others prioritize healthcare admin + strong customer service. We’ll match based on fit. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points) - Clincal experience supporting AU/UK/US/NZ patients. - Familiarity with any EHR/EMR (e.g., Best Practice, Halaxy, SimplePractice, Athena, DrChrono, Practice Better, Kareo, etc.). - Experience with CRMs/ticketing tools (e.g., Podium, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk). - VoIP/SMS tools experience (RingCentral, Dialpad, Twilio-based systems). - Pharmacy coordination or medication follow-up experience (within policy). - Training in de-escalation, complaint handling, or mental health first aid. - Experience supporting wellness-focused services (pain, stress, sleep, integrative care, allied health). Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based) - Location: Philippines (remote) - Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift) UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening) US-friendly (PH night shift) - Strong preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clear handoffs. title: Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality)
description: About Us We’re building a global talent pool of exceptional remote Medical Scribes / Documentation QA Specialists to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative care, and allied health support. Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—by supporting clinicians with accurate, consistent documentation so patients receive safe, continuous care and clinics can operate with confidence. If you’re detail-oriented, privacy-minded, and love creating clean, clinician-ready charts, we’d love to meet you. Role Overview As a Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality), you’ll help ensure patient charts are complete, accurate, and easy for clinicians to use. Depending on clinic assignment, your work may include real-time or near-real-time scribing during telehealth visits, post-visit documentation cleanup, and ongoing chart audits to maintain consistent standards. This is a pooling/talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to open roles with clinics based on: • Your scribing and documentation experience (telehealth, in-person, specialty exposure) • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US) • EHR systems you’ve used (or your ability to learn quickly) • Compensation alignment and expected workload volume Note: You do not provide medical advice. You support documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and compliance-minded recordkeeping. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) • Create or refine visit documentation using clinic templates (e.g., SOAP, HPI, ROS, assessment, plan, patient instructions). • Scribe during or immediately after telehealth visits when assigned (accurate, concise, clinician-ready). • QA charts for completeness: required fields, signatures, coding support fields (if applicable), and follow-up tasks. • Standardize formatting and terminology while preserving the clinician’s intent and clinical accuracy. • Ensure documentation supports continuity of care: clear next steps, follow-up timelines, and patient education notes. • Flag missing information or documentation risks to clinicians using a structured escalation workflow. • Maintain consistent use of tags, problem lists, medication lists, allergies, and history updates (per policy). • Support clinic documentation standards: macros, templates, smart phrases, and style guides. • Perform periodic chart audits (sample-based) and report trends: common misses, training needs, template gaps. • Coordinate asynchronously with clinicians and ops teams for corrections and handoffs. • Protect patient privacy and follow confidentiality/security practices at all times. Must-Have Qualifications • 3+ years of experience in medical scribing, clinical documentation, medical transcription, chart auditing, or similar healthcare documentation roles. • Strong written English with excellent grammar and ability to summarize accurately. • Familiarity with medical terminology and common documentation structures (SOAP, HPI, etc.). • High attention to detail—able to spot inconsistencies, missing fields, and documentation gaps. • Comfort working inside EHR/EMR systems and following structured templates. • Ability to work fast without sacrificing accuracy, especially under time pressure. • Strong privacy mindset (healthcare confidentiality, minimum necessary access, secure handling). • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and proactive communication. • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, stable internet, and secure device practices. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points) • Telehealth scribing experience (live or near-live). • Experience with any EHR/EMR (e.g., Best Practice, Halaxy, SimplePractice, Athena, DrChrono, Kareo, Practice Better, etc.). • Experience supporting multiple specialties (primary care, allied health, integrative care, mental health, pain, sleep). • Familiarity with documentation compliance expectations and chart audit processes. • Exposure to ICD-10/CPT basics or clinical coding support (not required; depends on clinic assignment). • Strong template-building skills (macros, smart phrases, standard note formats). • Experience working with international teams and time zone handoffs. Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples) • EHR/EMR: any system (training provided per clinic); comfort learning new workflows quickly • Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack/Teams, Notion/Trello/Asana • Documentation aids: approved templates, smart phrases/macros (clinic-specific) • Voice (if used): VoIP platforms for live visits (clinic-specific) Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based) • Location: Philippines (remote) • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift) • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening) • US-friendly (PH night shift) • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clear async updates. Compensation (General Guidance) Starts at USD 10/hour. Higher rates may apply for: • strong scribing track record (telehealth/live) • demonstrated QA/auditing experience • speed + accuracy at volume • experience building documentation templates/macros Some clinics may offer incentives based on accuracy and turnaround time. How to Apply (Required) Please submit: 1. CV / Resume 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering: • Your documentation/scribing background • EHR systems you’ve used (or how you learn new ones fast) • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US) • Your approach to accuracy, privacy, and fast turnaround 3. Optional but strongly recommended: 1–2 anonymized writing samples (remove all identifying/patient data), such as: • a sample SOAP note you created, or • a “before/after” documentation cleanup example Important: Do not submit any document containing real patient identifiers. Our Screening Process (What to Expect) • Initial screen (English writing + documentation experience + remote readiness) • Practical test (timed): create a structured note from a mock transcript + QA checklist • Structured interview: scenarios on accuracy, privacy, clinician collaboration, and handling missing info Join the Pool If you take pride in clean charts, love structured work, and want to help clinicians deliver better care through excellent documentation, we’d love to hear from you.

([Petrosoft][3]) #### Skills * Data entry accuracy * Fuel inventory reconciliation * Invoice processing * Inventory management * Problem-solving * Reporting and recordkeeping * Communication and teamwork #### Physical Requirements * Ability to sit for extended periods. * Ability to review reports and enter data accurately. #### Performance Metrics * Accuracy of fuel data entry. * Timeliness of invoice and fuel reconciliation completion. * Reduction of fuel inventory variances. * Accuracy of reporting and record maintenance. * Compliance with company procedures and deadlines.

title: Online Research Specialist — Developer Identity & Contact Discovery (Long-Term, Full-Time)
job_title: Online Research Specialist — Developer Identity & Contact Discovery (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description: Type: Full-time · 100% Remote · Long-term (we want someone to grow with us for years) Salary: ?40,000/month (with a raise at 90 days based on performance) · Paid bi-weekly Hours: 40 hrs/week, with at least 40 hours overlapping Sydney, Australia Start: With a paid 2-week trial before we commit to the full salary --- About the role We're a small, fast-moving data/intelligence company. We track people who do high-quality technical work in open source — engineers who actively contribute code to public projects. Your job is to take a contributor we've identified (you'll usually have a name and/or email plus a link to their code activity) and confirm who they really are across the open web: their personal website, professional profiles, publications, and public contact details. This is careful detective work — not bulk scraping. We care far more about being right than being fast. One confidently wrong match is worse to us than ten honest "I couldn't confirm this." If you take pride in getting things exactly right and you enjoy a good puzzle, you'll like this job. What you'll do day to day - Start from a developer's email and/or name plus links to their public code activity. - Search the open web to find and confirm the same person: personal/portfolio site, GitHub/GitLab, LinkedIn, Google Scholar, arXiv or other publications, blog, X/Twitter, conference talks, university or company pages. - Cross-check evidence so you're confident it's genuinely the same person (matching email , reused username, photo, bio, employer, location). - Record each finding in our tool: every link, what type it is, and how confident you are, with the reason why. - Flag hard cases (common names, conflicting evidence) for review instead of guessing. - Keep your work organized, sourced, and easy for us to audit. You're a great fit if you - Are genuinely good at online research / people-finding and enjoy the hunt. - Have strong English reading comprehension and write clear, short notes. - Are extremely detail-oriented and honest about uncertainty — you say "not sure" when you're not sure. - Are comfortable around developer/tech websites (GitHub, Stack Overflow, etc.), even if you're not a programmer. - Are reliable, self-managing, and consistent over the long term. - Handle people's personal information responsibly and confidentially — we work only with publicly available info and we respect privacy. Nice to have (not required) - Experience as a VA, lead-generation researcher, recruiter/sourcer, or data researcher. - Familiarity with Google Sheets, Boolean search, LinkedIn, or Google Scholar. - Any exposure to software/tech communities. Compensation & growth - ?40,000/month full-time after the trial. - Paid 2-week trial first (same hourly rate) so we both make sure it's a fit. - Performance review and raise at 90 days, tied to accuracy and consistency. - Long-term, stable role with training — we're hiring someone to stay. Requirements: Reliable computer, stable internet, and a quiet space to record a short audio clip. --- How to apply (read carefully — most applicants will be rejected for skipping a step) We receive a lot of AI-generated and copy-paste applications. The steps below are designed so a real researcher passes easily and a bot fails. Do all five, in order — applications missing the recording, the screenshot, or the keyword are deleted unread: 1. Start your message with this exact phrase: CONTRIBUTOR-7741. Then, on the next line, finish this sentence in your own words (1–2 sentences, your real opinion): "The hardest part of confirming someone's identity online is…" 2. Mini-task. Find out who the GitHub user matklad really is, and tell me: - (a) Their full real name. - (b) The two specific links you used to confirm it — paste the actual URLs — and for each, the one detail on that page that ties it to the same person. - (c) One thing you found this month — their most recent public post, commit, talk, or release — with the date and a link. - (d) One link you ruled OUT — something that looked like them but wasn't — and why. - (e) Your confidence (High / Medium / Low) and the reason. 3. A screenshot of one of the pages from step 2, taken on your own screen (we'd like to see your browser tabs / clock in it). 4. A 60–90 second screen recording (Loom is free) of you doing any one search step, talking through what you're looking at, out loud in English. Audio required. This is the most important step. 5. At the very end, answer in one line: "What did you have for breakfast today, and what's the weather like where you are right now?" We reply to everyone who completes all five steps. We're hiring for the long term and will invest in training the right person.

Your job is to take that AI-generated content through the correct workflow, apply the required checks, and act as the final human reviewer before the content moves forward. The main goal is to make sure each post sounds clear, natural, useful, and human — not robotic, generic, or obviously AI-generated. ## What you’ll do You will take AI-generated content and move it through our internal workflow. You will follow a clear step-by-step process for reviewing, checking, and improving each post. You will use our prompts, tools, and editorial guidelines to refine content where needed. You will review each post to make sure it does not sound “AI-ified.” You will check for generic phrasing, robotic tone, repetitive structures, unnatural wording, and over-polished AI-style language. Apply feedback and internal guidelines accurately. ## Key responsibilities Move AI-generated content through the agreed workflow. Apply editorial checks to each post. Review posts for AI-style language and tone. Humanise wording where needed. Improve clarity, rhythm, and readability. Ability to make light edits without over-rewriting. Reliability and consistency when reviewing content at volume. ## Nice to have Experience reviewing social media content. Experience working with LinkedIn posts. Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI writing tools. Experience with content workflows, editorial QA, or agency content production. Understanding of tone-of-voice guidelines. ## What success looks like Content moves smoothly through the workflow. Posts are checked carefully before moving forward. AI-generated drafts sound more natural, specific, and human. Posts do not feel generic, robotic, or obviously AI-written. The original message is preserved while the quality is improved. Weak content is flagged rather than passed through. The final output feels polished, clear, and ready for review or publishing. ## Role summary This role is ideal for someone who is organised, detail-oriented, and has a strong instinct for natural writing. This is a long-term seat, not a churn-and-burn gig. We're looking for someone exceptional to grow with us. What this role is You'll be the right hand to two busy owners. Your job is simple to describe and demanding to do well: take things off our plate — the work we don't have time for, shouldn't be doing ourselves, or just need handled and off our minds. Sometimes you'll have a clear process to follow. Just as often you won't — and that's exactly where the right person shines. When there's no playbook, you research it, figure out the smartest way to do it, build the process, and get it done. We want someone we can hand a goal to, not just a task, and trust that it's handled. If you bring problems wrapped in solutions instead of just questions, and you take real ownership of your work, you'll love it here. If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this isn't the fit. What you'll help with A bit of everything across the business — it varies week to week. For example: Running and following up on recurring tasks across operations, admin, and our internal systems Tackling one-off projects and research: figuring out how something should be done, then doing it Coordinating with vendors, contractors, and our team Helping with marketing tasks (posting, publishing, organizing) when needed Turning the things we do into clean, repeatable processes so the business runs smoother over time The specific tasks are learnable. What we can't teach is the resourcefulness and drive to own them. Who you are Resourceful. When you hit something you don't know, you figure it out — you research, you learn, and you come back with a plan, not just a question. Proactive and ownership-driven. You anticipate what's needed, follow through without reminders, and treat our business like it's your own. Hungry, with an excellent work ethic and high standards. This matters more to us than your résumé. You take pride in your work and you don't cut corners. A sharp, fast learner who's comfortable with ambiguity and figures out the path forward. An excellent communicator in written and spoken English — clear, professional, and easy to work with. Organized and great with everyday tools (Google Workspace and similar), and quick to pick up new ones. Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) is a big plus — we love people who use them to move faster. Honest, discreet, and trustworthy — you'll handle sensitive information. 2+ years supporting executives, founders, or businesses is ideal (US experience a plus), but the right attitude and ability matter more than years on paper. The details Hours: Full-time, with some daily overlap with US Eastern Time (we'll work out the exact hours together). Pay: $7–$10/hr depending on experience — and more for someone exceptional. Strong performers grow quickly from here. Location: Fully remote, work from home. Type: Long-term. We want someone to build a future with us. How to apply Two quick steps: Send a short message here on OnlineJobs.ph starting with the word "COMPASS" (this is how we know you read the whole ad). Include your monthly salary expectation and your available hours in US Eastern Time. Complete a short video interview — this is the main part of your application. It only takes a few minutes and you record it on your own time: ???? Apply here: ---------- In the video, tell us about (1) a time you were handed something with little or no instruction, and you figured it out and got it done, and (2) why this role excites you and what makes you the person we're looking for. We read every complete application (message + video) and reply to the ones that are a fit. We're excited to meet you.

This is non-negotiable. - Strong written and verbal English communication skills — comfortable drafting executive-quality email s and notes. - Confidence and professionalism on live calls with finance and billing contacts at other companies. - Demonstrated attention to detail, especially with numbers, dates, contract terms, and reconciliation. - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. - Strong judgment about when to act independently vs. when to escalate. - Comfort with US business hours and direct collaboration with US-based personnel. - Hands-on experience with our core revenue stack — HubSpot, Stripe, and Zapier — is strongly preferred. title: Artist Research & Scouting Specialist
description: We are looking for a detail-oriented research specialist to help us identify and compile independent music artists who meet a specific set of criteria. This is a research and data collection role. You will not be doing outreach — your job is to find the right artists, verify they meet our requirements, and deliver clean, organized lead reports. Quality is everything in this role. We do not want volume. We want accuracy. Every lead you submit should be one you have personally verified against the full checklist. Scouts who consistently submit unqualified leads will not continue with us. What You'll Be Doing: Searching for independent music artists across YouTube and Spotify who match our target profile. Verifying each artist against a detailed checklist before submitting. Collecting specific data points for each artist and organizing them into clean reports. Submitting leads in batches on a regular schedule with notes on why each artist qualifies. Target Artist Profile: Genres we are focused on: Phonk (all types including drift, slowed and reverb, Brazilian phonk), Synthwave, Retrowave, Electronic, Lo-fi, Ambient, and similar instrumental or electronic music styles. Priority regions: Russia, Kazakhstan, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Belarus, and other Eastern European and CIS countries. Latin America and Asia are also welcome. Any country is acceptable but the listed regions are highest priority. Minimum size requirements: At least 500K monthly listeners on Spotify, OR multiple tracks with 2 million or more views on YouTube. Distribution: Artists must be on DistroKid, TuneCore, standard Amuse, Routenote, or self-distribution. Do not submit artists on The Orchard, Black 17, Chillhop, Create Music Group, Believe, or any major label. What to Look For: Original music only — no covers, no slowed and reverb versions of mainstream hits. Active YouTube channel with consistent uploads and views. Independent-looking artists with no obvious label affiliation. User-generated content presence — search the artist's song titles on YouTube and TikTok and note how many non-official videos are using their music. This is an important signal and should be included in every report. Verification Process — Follow This Exactly: Step one: Check the YouTube video description. Look at the "Provided to YouTube by" line to identify the distributor. Look at the copyright line — "Copyright Control" or the artist's own name is a green flag. Any third-party company name is a red flag. Step two: Search the artist name and song titles in the ASCAP and BMI public databases. If nothing comes up, that is a strong green flag. If a third-party publisher appears, do not submit the artist. Step three: Check Spotify credits on the artist's top tracks. Look for any publisher or admin name listed. Artist's own name or nothing at all is what we want. Only submit an artist after completing all three steps. Red Flags — Do Not Submit These: Artists signed to or distributed by Black 17, Phonk Point if heavily branded, The Orchard, Chillhop, Create Music Group, Believe, or any major label. Cover songs or slowed and reverb versions of mainstream artists like Travis Scott or Drake. Artists with very low activity, dead profiles, or no uploads in the past 6 months. Any artist with a visible third-party publisher or admin in their credits. What to Submit for Every Artist: Artist name. Main YouTube channel link. Spotify artist link if available. Top 1 to 2 songs with view and stream counts. Distributor identified from YouTube credits. Any label name visible in credits. Estimated monthly listeners or total views. Instagram link, email if visible on YouTube About tab or Linktree, and any other contact information you can find. Number of user-generated videos using their music on YouTube and TikTok — search the song title and note what you find. Your personal notes on why this artist qualifies. Priority Tiers: Tier 1 (submit first, highest priority): 1M or more monthly Spotify listeners or multiple tracks above 5M YouTube views, fully clean credits, active UGC use, Eastern European or CIS region. Tier 2: 500K to 1M monthly listeners or 2M to 5M YouTube views, clean credits, original music, any region. Tier 3: Below minimum thresholds but exceptional UGC presence or one standout viral track — flag these separately and we will review individually. Non-Negotiable Requirements: You must be able to navigate YouTube and Spotify fluently. You must be comfortable using ASCAP and BMI public search databases. Every lead must be personally verified — do not submit artists you have not checked yourself. Ability to read and navigate Cyrillic profiles and Russian-language pages is a strong advantage and will be prioritized in hiring. Organized, consistent reporting — leads must be submitted in the format specified, no exceptions. You Are Probably NOT a Fit If: You prioritize quantity over quality. You are not familiar with independent music distribution or how to read YouTube video credits. You cannot commit to a consistent weekly batch of verified leads. You have no experience researching artists or creators online. Application Requirements — All Three Are Mandatory: Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. First, submit 5 sample artist leads using the exact format above. These should be real artists you have found and verified yourself — this is the most important part of your application and shows us immediately whether you understand the role. Second, describe your research process: how would you find artists in these genres who are not already on our radar? What platforms, tools, or methods would you use? Third, confirm whether you can read Cyrillic or navigate Russian-language pages, and list any tools you use for music research. Leave your telegram down below as well.

"I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. description: # JOB POST #1 — AI UGC Ad Creator **Job Title:** Full-Time AI UGC Video Creator / Short-Form Ad Editor **Location:** Remote — Philippines **Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week. Must be available for overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. **Salary:** USD $800 per month **Start Date:** ASAP ## About the Role ModernMed is looking for a highly creative AI Video Creator who can produce realistic, high-quality UGC-style short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You will create original videos featuring AI-generated virtual actors, product visuals, scenes, voiceovers, and realistic user-generated-content style presentations. We will provide product direction, brand assets, scripts, reference videos, and examples of styles we want recreated. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to make AI-generated content feel natural, modern, engaging, and native to TikTok and Instagram. ## Responsibilities * Create 4-6 short-form vertical videos per day. * Produce realistic AI UGC-style ads featuring virtual actors, product visuals, scenes, dialogue, and voiceovers. * Create AI-generated people holding, discussing, or presenting ModernMed product packaging and vials. * Turn provided scripts, hooks, product concepts, and references into engaging video ads. * Study provided reference videos and identify similar TikTok, Instagram, and Reels trends. * Build a research folder with screenshots, links, hooks, editing styles, caption styles, and trend ideas. * Recreate the style and structure of reference content while keeping every final video original. * Maintain consistent visual quality across AI characters, product shots, colors, labels, and branding. * Organize prompts, project files, raw assets, and final exported videos. ## Preferred Qualifications * Experience creating AI UGC ads. * Experience creating realistic AI characters. * Experience with fitness, wellness, beauty, educational, or product-based content. * Experience recreating viral TikTok ad styles. * Motion graphics skills are a plus. ## How to Apply Please send: * Your short-form video editing portfolio * Examples of AI-generated videos you have created * Your expected start date * A short message explaining why you are a good fit * Your favorite AI-generated ad you have made and why it performed well Applicants who can complete a short paid test task will be prioritized. English Only.

title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description: Job Title: Client Growth & Success Specialist (Full-Time, Remote) Location: Remote Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month + 5,000 PHP sign-on bonus + quarterly performance bonuses after probation About us We are a North American digital marketing agency that works exclusively with lash extension businesses across the United States and Canada. We run paid advertising, lead generation, and end-to-end booking operations for approximately 50 lash studio owners. We cover our clients' ad spend, manage their leads, and book appointments on their behalf — all for a flat weekly fee. We are a fast-growing, results-driven company that holds itself to a high standard. Every person on our team has a direct impact on client outcomes and company growth. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot. About This Role This is a full-time remote position that combines two functions: inbound discovery sales and client success management. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team. This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step. Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset. Schedule Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST) 30-minute unpaid lunch break Two 15-minute breaks per day You must be fully available and online during all working hours. Please verify the MST time zone against your local time before applying. Late starts, early finishes, and unexplained absences will not be tolerated. What You Will Be Doing Discovery Calls Get on Zoom calls with prospective clients who have reached out to learn about Swoop Lift Introduce yourself and explain our services clearly and confidently Assess whether the prospect is a qualified fit for our program Book a follow-up call with our Lash Growth Specialist for qualified prospects Handle any objections the prospect raises calmly and professionally Client Success Management Respond promptly and professionally to existing client questions via WhatsApp and other channels Get on Zoom calls with clients to review their monthly performance reports Handle client concerns and complaints with empathy and composure Overcome objections from clients who are frustrated, uncertain, or pushing back Escalate serious concerns to management through the proper internal process Keep accurate notes and records on every client interaction Requirements English — This Is Non-Negotiable This role requires a level of English proficiency that is indistinguishable from a native speaker in both spoken and written form. Our clients are North American small business owners. Any accent, grammatical error, or awkward phrasing that makes a client feel they are speaking to someone overseas will damage the client relationship and reflect poorly on Swoop Lift. You must speak English fluently and clearly with no accent that would be noticeable or distracting to a North American client. You will be on Zoom calls every single day with your camera on. You must write in flawless English — correct grammar, correct spelling, correct punctuation, and natural phrasing — at a fast typing speed. All client communication is written and must be professional and error-free. You must be able to produce all written communication yourself without the use of AI writing tools. We test for this during the hiring process and throughout employment. Use of AI to write client-facing messages is grounds for immediate termination. You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you. Other Requirements You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional. You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls. You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally. You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do. You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously. You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently. What We Are Not Looking For Candidates who need to be told what to do in every situation Candidates who use AI to write their responses and pass it off as their own work Candidates who struggle under pressure or become flustered when clients are difficult Candidates who are not fully available during the required working hours Candidates whose spoken or written English requires any effort for a North American to understand If any of the above describes you, please do not apply. Compensation Base Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month Sign-On Bonus: 5,000 PHP upon successful completion of probation Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based, available after probation — details discussed during the interview Employment Type: Full-time, remote How to Apply We do not accept applications through this platform alone. To be considered you must complete both of the following steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed. Step 1 — Download Telegram and send your resume to: ---------- Step 2 — Record a video of yourself responding to the following objection as if you are speaking to a real client on a Zoom call: "I love what you guys do and it sounds amazing but honestly I just cannot afford it right now. It is too much money for me at this stage." Video requirements: Camera must be on. We need to see your face. State the current date clearly at the beginning of the video. Videos without the date will not be accepted. Length should be between 2 and 4 minutes. Speak naturally. Do not read from a script. Audio must be clear and your background must be clean and professional. Send the video to the same Telegram number along with your resume. The video is your first impression. Treat it like the interview has already started. Only candidates who impress us in the video will be contacted for the next stage.

description: About the Role We are a fast-growing fashion e-commerce company running multiple Shopify stores across the US, UK, Netherlands, and other markets. We are looking for a detail-oriented Product Listing Specialist to build and deliver complete, publish-ready product pages following our step-by-step Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). description: About the Role We are a fast-growing Career Consulting Firm dedicated to helping professionals advance their careers through strategic coaching, resume optimization, and job search support. We’re looking for a high-energy, consultative Sales Development Representative who thrives on connecting with people, uncovering their career goals, and guiding them toward solutions that create real impact. This is not just a transactional sales role—you’ll act as a trusted advisor, helping clients invest in their future. If you’re driven by results, confident in closing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, this role is for you. ________________________________________ What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) 1. Lead Conversion & Sales Execution • Engage inbound and outbound leads via phone, email , SMS, and virtual consultations • Conduct discovery calls to understand client career challenges, goals, and urgency • Present tailored consulting solutions and confidently close high-value service packages • Overcome objections using a consultative, value-based sales approach 2. Relationship Building & Client Trust • Build rapport quickly and establish credibility as a career partner • Follow up consistently to nurture leads through the sales funnel • Deliver a high-quality, professional experience that reflects our brand 3. Pipeline & CRM Management • Manage a high volume of leads and opportunities simultaneously • Track all interactions, notes, and deal stages in CRM systems • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility 4. Performance & KPI Ownership • Consistently meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets • Track key metrics such as conversion rate, call volume, and revenue generated • Continuously refine your sales approach based on performance insights 5. Continuous Improvement & Tools • Leverage modern tools (CRM, automation, and AI platforms) to improve efficiency • Stay updated on industry trends in recruiting, job search strategies, and career coaching • Participate in training, roleplays, and team strategy sessions ________________________________________ What We’re Looking For (Qualifications) Core Skills • Exceptional spoken and written English with a neutral or professional accent • Strong phone presence with confidence in leading conversations • Proven experience in closing sales (preferably high-ticket or service-based) Sales Mindset • Consultative selling skills (needs discovery, objection handling, closing) • Goal-oriented with a track record of hitting or exceeding quotas • Resilient, persistent, and comfortable handling rejection Technical & Organizational • Experience with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a fast-moving pipeline • Familiarity with or willingness to learn AI tools and sales automation platforms Personality Traits • Self-starter with high accountability • Coachable and open to feedback • Empathetic listener who can connect with clients on a personal level • Competitive, driven, and motivated by performance-based rewards ________________________________________ Compensation & Growth • Base Salary: 40,000 PHP/month • Uncapped commission structure (high earning potential) • Performance bonuses and incentives • Top performers can earn 80,000 – 120,000+ PHP/month • Opportunity for full-time conversion after 2 months, including benefits and career advancement ________________________________________ Why Join Us? • Be part of a mission-driven company helping people transform their careers • Work in a fast-paced, high-growth sales environment • Access to modern sales tools, automation, and AI systems • Clear path for advancement into senior sales or leadership roles • Collaborative, supportive, and performance-focused team culture ________________________________________ Who This Role is Perfect For • Sales professionals who love closing and earning commission • Individuals passionate about helping others succeed professionally • Remote workers who thrive in a metrics-driven environment • Candidates looking for rapid growth and long-term opportunity ________________________________________ Ready to Apply? If you’re a confident closer who can turn conversations into conversions and wants to grow in a high-impact sales role, we’d love to hear from you.

description: About Coastal Communications Coastal Communications is a growing U.S.-based telecommunications engineering and infrastructure services company.
