This position requires someone who can understand contracts, purchase orders, project records, employee time, billing rates, and supporting documentation—not simply create basic invoices. Position Summary The Billing Specialist will prepare accurate and timely invoices for Coastal Communications’ clients. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with a mixture of: Simple fixed-fee and recurring invoices Hourly and time-and-material billing Project milestone and percentage-completion billing Unit-based or production billing Purchase order and work order billing Detailed telecommunications and engineering billing Invoice backup packages and client-specific billing requirements This role will work closely with company leadership, project managers, operations personnel, accounting staff, employees, and independent contractors to confirm that all completed work is properly documented and billed. Key Responsibilities Prepare, review, and submit client invoices accurately and on schedule. Review contracts, proposals, purchase orders, statements of work, work authorizations, and client billing instructions. Match employee and contractor time entries to approved billing rates, projects, tasks, and purchase orders. Prepare billing for hourly, fixed-fee, milestone, unit-based, recurring, and time-and-material projects. Verify that invoices include all required supporting documentation. Create organized invoice packages containing timesheets, production reports, field records, deliverables, receipts, and other required backup. Track project budgets, authorized amounts, billing limits, purchase order balances, and previously invoiced amounts. Identify unbilled work, missing time, incomplete records, billing discrepancies, and potential revenue leakage. Communicate with project managers and staff to resolve missing or inaccurate billing information. Maintain billing schedules and ensure invoices are submitted before client deadlines. Enter invoices and related information into QuickBooks or other accounting and project-management systems. Monitor accounts receivable and prepare reports showing invoice status, payment status, aging, and outstanding balances. Follow up professionally regarding overdue invoices, rejected invoices, or requests for revised documentation. Maintain accurate electronic billing files and client records. Assist with account reconciliation, collections support, reporting, and month-end billing close. Recommend improvements to billing procedures, internal controls, and documentation processes. Protect confidential company, client, employee, and financial information. Required Qualifications At least three years of billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or accounting-support experience. Strong experience preparing invoices from contracts, purchase orders, timesheets, rate sheets, and project records. Comfortable managing both simple invoices and detailed technical or project-based billing. Advanced attention to detail and accuracy. Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills. Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software. Ability to understand billing rates, quantities, units, project codes, task codes, and budget limits. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based managers, employees, vendors, and clients. Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple billing deadlines without constant supervision. Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote working environment. Willingness to maintain reasonable working-hour overlap with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone. Preferred Qualifications Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred: Telecommunications Fiber-optic engineering or construction Utility or infrastructure services Architecture or engineering Construction Professional services Field services Government contracting Project-based consulting Additional preferred experience includes: QuickBooks Online Accounts-receivable aging and collections Purchase order reconciliation Progress or milestone billing Time-and-material billing Contractor and employee timesheet review Client billing portals Month-end closing procedures Project-management or timekeeping platforms Technical Billing Expectations Applicants do not need to be telecommunications engineers. However, the selected candidate must be willing and able to learn terminology associated with projects such as: Fiber design and field engineering Permitting and right-of-way services GIS and CAD drafting Utility coordination Pole surveys and inspections Traffic-control plans Small-cell and wireless projects Construction inspection As-built documentation Project deliverables and production units The Billing Specialist must be able to connect completed technical work to the correct project, purchase order, contract rate, billing unit, and invoice documentation. What Success Looks Like A successful Billing Specialist will: Submit accurate invoices by every required deadline. Reduce missed or delayed billing. Identify completed work that has not yet been invoiced. Maintain accurate purchase order and project-balance records. Provide complete supporting documentation with each invoice. Resolve billing discrepancies promptly. Keep leadership informed of unbilled revenue, overdue invoices, and potential billing issues. Create organized systems that make billing easier to review and audit. Work Schedule This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines. Your expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos. Your availability to begin. Your preferred working hours and ability to overlap with U.S. Pacific Time. title: Senior Cold Email Strategist (Experts Only)
description: We are hiring a cold email expert — someone who has spent years doing this at a high level and has the numbers to prove it. If you are still learning, this is not the role for you. We need someone who can walk in, build the entire system from scratch, and consistently deliver results without being managed. We are a founder-led company with no existing cold email infrastructure. You will own everything from technical setup to copywriting to optimization. Leads will be provided to you — your job is to build the system that converts them into replies and booked conversations. Our team will not be guiding you. You will be guiding us. You Must Have: Minimum 3–5 years of dedicated cold email experience — not general marketing, not social media. Cold email specifically. A consistent, documented track record of 5%+ positive reply rates (not open rates — actual interested replies) across multiple campaigns. Experience running campaigns across multiple industries and ICPs — not just one niche. Deep technical knowledge: you have personally configured SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and managed domain and inbox health from scratch many times. Experience managing high-volume infrastructure across multiple domains and inboxes with proper sending rotation. Strong enough copywriting ability that your email s get mistaken for handwritten outreach — not templates. Experience diagnosing and fixing deliverability problems — you've been in spam before and you know exactly how to get out. What You'll Build & Run: Infrastructure: Full domain and inbox strategy covering quantity, naming, and age strategy. DNS setup with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured correctly from day one. Inbox warming protocol and ongoing deliverability monitoring. Sending platform setup and configuration using Instantly, Smartlead, or equivalent. Copywriting: Multi-step sequences written to generate replies, not just opens. Subject lines, openers, CTAs, and follow-up timing — all tested and optimized. Copy adapted to different audiences as our targeting evolves — we work with independent music artists and YouTube creators, so comfort with the creator economy is a strong plus. Ongoing A/B testing with clear documentation of what moved the needle and why. Reporting: Weekly performance reports covering open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, and meetings booked. Plain-language analysis of what's working and what needs to change. Honest assessment — if the copy or targeting angle is the bottleneck, we expect you to say so directly. Non-Negotiable Requirements: You must be able to provide specific campaign data including industry, offer, reply rate, and outcome. Vague answers disqualify immediately. You must have worked with at least 3 different sending platforms — not just one tool. Fluent written English is mandatory — you are writing email s to English-speaking decision-makers, creators, and artists. You must be comfortable owning results, not just activities. We do not measure success by email s sent. You Are Probably NOT a Fit If: Your experience is mostly internal email marketing or newsletters. You have only run campaigns in one or two industries. You cannot share reply rate data from past campaigns. You need significant direction or hand-holding. Your best campaigns averaged below 4% positive reply rate. Application Requirements — All Four Are Mandatory: Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. First, share 3 specific campaigns with the offer, target audience, sending volume, and positive reply rate. Screenshots or reports are strongly preferred. Second, provide a brief technical walkthrough describing how you would set up a brand new cold email system from scratch covering domains, inboxes, warming, DNS, and sending platform. This should take you two minutes to write if you know your craft. Third, write a 3-step cold email sequence for the following scenario: a platform that helps independent music artists and YouTube creators get brand deals and monetize their content, targeting the creators themselves. Show us what you can actually write. Fourth, list the tools you use for sending, email verification, and deliverability monitoring, and explain why you prefer each one.

Orthopedic surgery - Spine surgery -Musculoskeletal procedures - Pain-related spine procedures - Injections and procedure coding - Imaging-guided procedures, if applicable - E/M coding for orthopedic clinics - Modifiers commonly used in physician billing - Add-on codes and bundled procedure logic Required Qualifications Experience with U.S. physician/professional fee coding Experience coding or auditing orthopedic, spine, or musculoskeletal claims Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifiers Ability to read clinical documentation and determine what codes are supported Experience reviewing clinic notes, procedure notes, operative reports, claims, or superbills Strong written English Detail-oriented and able to explain coding rationale clearly Comfortable working with spreadsheets or structured audit templates Preferred Qualifications CPC, CCS-P, CPMA, or similar certification Orthopedic coding experience or specialty certification Experience as a medical coding auditor, ProFee coder, physician coding auditor, or revenue integrity coding specialist Experience identifying missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, or undercoding Experience with NCCI edits, bundling rules, payer rules, denials, or documentation improvement Familiarity with orthopedic/spine coding areas such as: Arthroscopy Fracture care Joint procedures Spine decompression/fusion procedures Epidural steroid injections Facet injections / medial branch blocks Radiofrequency ablation Trigger point / joint injections Durable medical equipment, braces, or orthotics, if applicable Important We are not looking for someone who only has experience with basic billing, charge entry, payment posting, or AR follow-up. job_title: Real Estate Cold Caller- Land and House Wholesaling
description: We are a real estate investment company that buys vacant land, lots, and residential properties directly from owners across the United States. We operate virtually and nationally. We are growing and looking for a driven, professional cold caller to join our team full time. ABOUT THE ROLE Your primary job is making outbound calls to property owners across the United States to identify motivated sellers who may be interested in a cash offer for their property. This is not a high pressure sales role. It is a relationship and qualification role. Your job is to have warm, genuine conversations, understand the seller's situation, gather property information, and identify whether there is a fit for our buying criteria. Full scripts, training, and all tools are provided. Real estate experience is a strong plus but we will train the right person. WHAT YOU WILL DO Make high volume outbound calls to property owners using our power dialer. Conduct warm, professional conversations based on provided scripts. Send immediate SMS follow up texts to contacts who did not answer or requested a callback. Qualify sellers by asking the right questions about their property and motivation. Log all call and text notes and activity in our CRM after every interaction. Identify and flag hot leads for immediate follow up by the acquisitions team. Manage follow up sequences combining calls and texts until a lead responds or is disqualified. Participate in brief weekly check-ins with the team. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required: Clear, confident, and warm phone voice. Reliable high speed internet connection. Quiet professional calling environment. Available Monday through Friday during US Eastern business hours. Strong written English for CRM note taking. Honest, dependable, and detail oriented. Takes initiative and does not wait to be told what to do. Flexible and adapts quickly when conversations take unexpected turns. Thinks on their feet and stays composed under pressure. Every seller is different and you need to meet them where they are. Strongly Preferred: Experience cold calling for US real estate investors or wholesalers. Familiarity with motivated seller outreach and land or house deals. Experience with CRM tools such as GoHighLevel, FreedomSoft, REsimpli, or similar. GoHighLevel experience is a strong plus as it is the platform we work in. English speakers are strongly encouraged to apply. Bilingual English and Spanish is an additional advantage but is not required. COMPENSATION AND HOURS $5 per hour Full time — 40 hours per week. Opportunity to increase pay based on performance and results. Long term role with growth potential as the company scales. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS This is a results-oriented role in a supportive environment. We invest in our team and want you to succeed. We also move fast and expect our callers to do the same. An experienced caller using our power dialer is expected to: Complete 300 to 500 dials per day. Have 50 to 100 live conversations per day. Send SMS follow ups to all unanswered contacts same day. Identify and log 3 to 8 qualified leads per day. Flag at least 1 HOT lead per day for immediate team follow up. If you have experience with power dialers and motivated seller calling you will recognize these as very achievable numbers. If high volume calling combined with a warm professional approach sounds like your strength, this role is built for you. If you prefer a slower pace this is not the right fit and that is completely okay. HOW TO APPLY To be considered please do both of the following. Applications missing either of these will not be reviewed. 1. Submit your resume or work history with relevant experience highlighted. 2. Answer these questions in writing: a. Describe a specific cold calling campaign you have worked on. What were you calling about, what was your approach, and what results did you get? b. Have you ever called motivated sellers for a real estate investor or wholesaling company? If yes, please describe the experience. c. Tell us about a time you had to think quickly and adapt during a difficult conversation. What happened and how did you handle it? We are not looking for someone to read a script robotically. We are looking for someone who is genuinely warm, professional, takes initiative, and takes pride in every conversation. Our sellers are real people going through real situations and we treat them with care and respect. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

description: Developer – Remote Part-Time Role in growing european agency We are looking for a skilled, reliable and highly trustworthy developer to join our small European digital company. We are a relatively new company, but we already work with active clients and larger development projects. Our team works fully remote, and we are looking for someone who can become a long-term part of what we are building. This is not a short-term task-based role. We are looking for someone who can grow with us over time. The position starts at 4 hours per working day, with the possibility of becoming full-time later as the company and workload grow. What you will work on You will work on both our own platform and client projects. The work will include different types of development tasks, such as: Development of our own platform and CMS Working with Payload CMS and our custom setup built on top of it Building pages and features based on designs Client website development Bug fixes and technical problem solving Support tasks and smaller client requests Improving existing features and workflows Some tasks will be practical, such as taking a design and building it in our system. Other tasks may be more technical, such as fixing errors, improving functionality or working with APIs. We need someone who can handle both. Technologies we use You should be comfortable working with: TypeScript Node.js Next.js React Payload CMS PostgreSQL REST / GraphQL APIs You do not have to be an expert in every single technology from day one, but you must be a strong developer who understands modern web development and complex systems. AI and Claude Code We use AI actively in our development workflow. You will get access to Claude Code, and we expect you to use it as much as possible to work faster and better. However, we are not looking for someone who simply copies AI-generated code. You must understand the code, be able to make good technical decisions, test your work and take responsibility for the final result. Who you will work with You will work closely with one of the company owners, who is also a developer with 20+ years of experience from large and complex development projects. This means you will have the opportunity to learn, discuss technical solutions, ask questions and develop side by side with someone highly experienced. We are looking for someone who wants to improve, take responsibility and become a stronger developer over time. Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is: A skilled developer Reliable and honest Self-driven Good at solving problems Able to work independently Easy to communicate with Fluent in English Comfortable joining short video calls when needed Interested in a long-term role Serious about quality We do not care if you have 1 year or 10 years of experience. What matters is that you are good, reliable and able to deliver quality work. Please do not apply if you are not confident that you can work with the technologies mentioned above. There will be a technical test, so applying without the right skills will only waste your time. Working hours This role starts with 4 hours per working day. Our preferred setup is that you work the same 4 hours each working day within this time window: 11:00–19:00 Central European Time During your working hours, we expect you to be available for: Short video calls Quick check-ins Questions and feedback Daily communication You will also be expected to upload or share your work every day, so we can follow your progress clearly. Communication Good communication is very important. Your English must be fluent enough that we can easily discuss tasks, technical problems, requirements and feedback. Since this is a remote role, we need someone who is responsive, clear and dependable. Hiring process The hiring process includes: A short unpaid technical test A fully paid 1-month trial period The technical test will take a few hours and is used to evaluate your skills, problem-solving and quality of work. The test will be limited in scope and is only used as part of the hiring process. The first month is a normal paid working month. During this month, we will evaluate whether the communication, quality and working relationship are a good fit. Long-term opportunity For the right person, this can become a very strong long-term opportunity. As the company grows, the role can grow too. There may be an opportunity to move into a full-time position and, in the future, potentially help lead a small development team. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and become an important part of what we are building. Salary This is a fixed monthly salary role based on your skills and experience. Please include your expected monthly salary for a part-time role of 4 hours per working day in your application. Start date We are looking for someone who can start on August 1st. How to apply Please send whatever you think is relevant for us to evaluate your skills. This can include: A short introduction about yourself Your development experience Examples of previous work GitHub, portfolio or code samples Your experience with TypeScript, Next.js, React, Payload CMS or similar systems Your experience using AI coding tools, especially Claude Code Your expected monthly salary for 4 hours per working day Which 4 hours you would prefer to work each working day within the 11:00–19:00 Central European Time window It is also a plus if you include a short video where you introduce yourself, explain your experience and show or describe your work setup. The platform helps businesses understand the difference between platform-reported performance and actual business outcomes by connecting advertising platforms, websites, CRM systems and revenue sources. Because the platform operates in a privacy-sensitive environment and processes attribution, tracking and revenue data, accuracy, reliability and data integrity are critical. Our customers rely on the platform to make marketing and business decisions. A bug, release issue or implementation mistake can impact reporting, attribution, revenue calculations, privacy-related functionality and customer trust. We are looking for a senior technical professional who can help ensure the platform remains stable, secure, maintainable and production-ready as it grows. ---------- Required Experience * 7+ years of professional software engineering, platform engineering, release engineering, QA engineering or technical leadership experience * 5+ years working with production SaaS applications * 5+ years reviewing production code and pull requests * Experience acting as a Technical Lead, Senior Engineer, Platform Engineer, Engineering Manager or similar role * Experience making architectural and technical decisions * Experience improving engineering standards and development processes * Experience with production releases and CI/CD workflows * Experience working with customer-facing production systems ---------- Must Have * Strong TypeScript experience * Strong Next.js and React experience * Strong backend review experience * Strong understanding of APIs and backend service design * Strong PostgreSQL and SQL knowledge * Experience with GitHub workflows and pull request reviews * Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines * Experience reviewing code for maintainability, security and scalability * Strong understanding of software architecture principles * Strong understanding of QA and release management processes * Strong written and spoken English ---------- Preferred Experience * Bun * Hono * Prisma * Kysely * PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) * Redis / BullMQ * Kubernetes * ArgoCD * Grafana * Loki * Prometheus * Stripe Billing * Application security * Privacy/GDPR-sensitive products * SaaS analytics, attribution or data platforms ---------- This Role Is Probably Not A Fit If * You primarily work as a manual QA tester * You have never reviewed other developers’ code * You have never been responsible for release quality * You have never worked on production SaaS systems * You are not comfortable challenging engineering decisions * You need detailed instructions for every task * You are looking for a ticket execution role rather than a technical leadership role ---------- The Role We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead who will act as an independent technical reviewer and second set of eyes for a growing SaaS platform. This is not a primary development role. You will not be responsible for building most product features. Instead, your responsibility is ensuring that engineering quality, architecture, releases, infrastructure and technical standards remain at a high level as the platform grows. You will work closely with the lead developer and founder while maintaining an independent technical perspective. You should be comfortable: * Reviewing code * Reviewing architecture decisions * Identifying technical debt * Challenging implementation decisions * Improving engineering standards * Improving release quality * Improving testing quality * Identifying security and privacy risks * Providing technical guidance when required Think of this role as a combination of: * Senior Engineer * Technical Lead * QA Lead * Release Manager * Platform Reviewer ---------- Technical Stack Languages * TypeScript * SQL (PostgreSQL) Frontend * Next.js 14 * React * App Router * Tailwind CSS * shadcn/ui Backend * Bun * Hono * Prisma * Kysely * Better Auth Data & Queueing * PostgreSQL 16 * JSONB * Row Level Security (RLS) * Redis * BullMQ Integrations * Stripe Billing * Usage Metering * Resend * React Email Infrastructure * Hetzner Kubernetes Engine * Kubernetes Secrets * S3-compatible storage * GitHub Actions * ArgoCD * Grafana * Loki * Prometheus You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be senior enough to understand how these systems interact and identify risks, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. ---------- Responsibilities Technical Review & Oversight You will regularly review development work and provide technical feedback. You should be comfortable reviewing: Frontend * Next.js * React * TypeScript * User flows * Responsive behaviour * Product requirements Backend * Bun * Hono * APIs * Authentication flows * Database interactions * Business logic * Data processing workflows Your focus is not only whether code works, but whether it is: * Maintainable * Scalable * Secure * Well structured * Consistent with project standards You should be able to identify: * Technical debt * Architectural risks * Security risks * Privacy-related implementation risks * Improper handling of sensitive data * Permission and access control issues ---------- Quality Assurance & Testing You will help ensure new functionality works correctly before it reaches production. This includes: * Feature validation * Regression testing * Acceptance testing * Release testing * Bug reproduction * Integration testing * User flow testing * Tracking validation * Revenue attribution validation You should be comfortable validating: * Frontend applications * APIs * Tracking systems * Revenue calculations * CRM integrations * User permissions * Reporting systems * Privacy and consent-related functionality ---------- GitHub, CI/CD & Release Management You will help maintain a professional software delivery process. This includes: * Branching strategies * Pull request workflows * Protected branches * Merge policies * GitHub Actions * CI/CD pipelines * Release validation * Deployment workflows * Staging reviews * Production release reviews * Rollback planning Your goal is to reduce risk and increase confidence in releases. ---------- Infrastructure & Platform Oversight You do not need to be a dedicated DevOps engineer. However, you should be comfortable reviewing infrastructure health and identifying operational risks. This includes: * Kubernetes environments * Docker environments * Monitoring dashboards * Logs and alerts * Resource usage * Secrets management * Access control reviews * Security-related deployment risks You should be able to identify issues before they become production i ---------- . ---------- Hands-On Technical Contributions While the primary focus of this role is review, quality assurance and technical leadership, you should also be comfortable making occasional improvements and fixes when appropriate. Examples include: * Small frontend fixes * Small backend fixes * CI/CD improvements * GitHub workflow improvements * Infrastructure improvements * Monitoring improvements * Configuration changes * Documentation improvements You will not be responsible for building major product features, but you should be comfortable contributing directly to the codebase when needed. ---------- What Success Looks Like * Engineering standards have improved * Releases are predictable and low risk * Code quality is consistently high * Technical debt is visible and managed * Security and privacy risks are identified early * Infrastructure is stable and well monitored * Bugs and regressions are caught before production * Developers receive actionable technical feedback * The founder has confidence that the platform is being built correctly
